items.title: 費半領漲！海外主動式ETF悄獲資金青睞 00411A月漲近13%奪冠
items.title_en: Fee Half Leads Gains! Overseas Active ETFs Quietly Attract Funds; 00411A Up Nearly 13% in a Month Takes the Crown
paras: 9 月非農就業低於預期，市場升息預期降溫，激勵上周五費半走強，連帶今(5)日台積電(2330-TW)一開盤就飆上2580元新天價，加權指數劍指5萬點大關。大盤衝高之際，主動式ETF市場上漲主力軍卻悄悄換人當，近一個月來漲幅領先的全是海外主動式ETF，主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)以月漲幅逼近13%，擠下一票主動式ETF老前輩登上冠軍，今天盤中00411A更刷新自身歷史新高價，展現領漲氣勢。
不同於上半年全球資金聚焦於亞股市場，隨著近來費半走勢反彈上攻，資金也開始顯著輪動。根據CMoney統計，近一個月費半指數大漲超過雙位數，表現遠優於日、韓、台等亞股；同樣的現象也發生在主動式ETF中，近一個月來績效前十名中，前七名都由海外主動式ETF包辦，8月底才掛牌的00411A月漲幅高達12.7%，拿下漲幅第一名。
除了00411A月漲幅超過雙位數外，近一個月來表現亮眼的還有主動元大AI新經濟(00990A-TW)、主動群益美國增長(00997A-TW)，及主動統一全球創新(00988A-TW)，這三檔月漲幅約在11%-10%之間。第五名則是主動安聯美國科技(00402A-TW)，月漲幅約9%。
而一向是市場寵兒的台股主動式ETF，近一個月漲幅冠軍則是主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)，月漲幅直逼8%。其次則是主動富邦台灣龍耀(00405A-TW)、主動台新龍頭成長(00986A-TW)，漲幅約7%左右。
展望後市，主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)經理人郭智偉表示，長線而言，美國經濟基本面良好，AI推動企業獲利續揚，且AI應用也有望步入快速成長期，股市長線多頭態勢不變。但在美國期中大選前，股市震盪難免，加上全球利率環境變化及地緣政治風險等短期雜音干擾，若股市出現拉回修正，應視為逢低布局機會。後續將持續關注AI及能源基建、AI軟體自動駕駛、太空經濟及量子運算等領域的投資布局機會。
主動式ETF近一個月漲幅排行前十名
資料來源：CMoney，月漲幅統計期間9/2-10/2

paras_en: In September, non‑farm payrolls came in below expectations, cooling expectations of further rate hikes. This helped the FEI Half‑index rally last Friday, and today (the 5th) TSMC (2330‑TW) opened at a new high of NT$2,580, pushing the weighted index toward the 50,000‑point mark. While the broad market surged, the leading drivers in the active‑ETF space quietly changed: over the past month, overseas active ETFs have posted the biggest gains, with Active UniFrontier Technology (00411A‑TW) posting a near‑13% monthly increase, displacing a veteran active ETF from the top spot. During intraday trading, 00411A even set a new historical high, showcasing its leading‑gain momentum.

Unlike the first half of the year when global capital was focused on Asian equities, the recent rebound in the FEI Half‑index has prompted a noticeable rotation of funds. According to CMoney data, the FEI Half‑index has surged by double‑digit percentages over the past month, outperforming Asian markets such as Japan, Korea and Taiwan. The same pattern appears in active ETFs: among the top ten performers over the past month, the first seven are all overseas active ETFs, and the newly listed 00411A posted a 12.7% monthly gain, ranking first in percentage increase.

In addition to 00411A’s double‑digit monthly rise, other standout performers over the past month include Active Yuanta AI New Economy (00990A‑TW), Active Cathay US Growth (00997A‑TW) and Active Uni Global Innovation (00988A‑TW), each posting monthly gains of roughly 11%‑10%. The fifth‑place spot goes to Active Allianz US Technology (00402A‑TW) with a monthly increase of about 9%.

The traditionally favored Taiwanese active ETFs saw the top monthly performer be Active Uni Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW), which nearly hit an 8% gain. It is followed by Active Fubon Taiwan Dragon Shine (00405A‑TW) and Active Taishin Leading Growth (00986A‑TW), both up around 7%.

Looking ahead, Active UniFrontier Technology (00411A‑TW) portfolio manager Guo Zhi‑wei said that in the long run the U.S. economy’s fundamentals remain strong, AI is driving corporate earnings higher, and AI applications are likely to enter a rapid growth phase, keeping the long‑term market bullish. However, ahead of the U.S. mid‑term elections, market volatility is inevitable, and short‑term noise from global interest‑rate shifts and geopolitical risks could trigger pull‑backs, which should be seen as buying opportunities on dips. The team will continue to monitor investment opportunities in AI, energy infrastructure, AI software for autonomous driving, space economy and quantum computing.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉健策展望穩健毛利率逐季增 衝7440元再創歷史新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Jianshe Outlook Steady Gross Margin Increases Quarterly, Surges to 7,440 TWD Setting New Historical High
paras: 健策(3653-TW)產品展望正面，法人指出，由於熱設計功耗(TDP)提高，加上晶片翹曲問題進一步加劇，預期明年起可拆式均熱片(TR Lid)的營收貢獻將提高，並從輝達(NVDA-US)Vera Rubin及Rubin Ultra開始導入，帶動ASP提升，毛利率表現可望逐季增溫，激勵健策今(5)日漲勢凌厲，衝上7440元續寫歷史新天價。
健策早盤以6800元開平盤，雖盤中一度翻黑跌至6760元，不過隨後翻紅走高，盤中最高衝上7440元，漲幅超過9%，截至午盤，股價暫報7315元，仍大漲逾半根停板，位居千金股第4名，僅次於信驊(5274-TW)、川湖(2059-TW)以及創意(3443-TW)。
法人表示，健策預計今年第四季將開始小量出貨TR Lid進行測試，若後續測試順利，貢獻度將在明年開始成長。法人並指出，TR Lid單價較現在高出數倍，將進一步帶動營收表現，預估明年營收可望年增逾1倍，毛利率也有機會突破50%。
健策日前公告自結，8月營收32.36億元，年增91%，稅後純益10.79億元，年增1.01倍，每股純益7.35%，年增95%。第二季營收72.75億元，年增40%，稅後純益23.18億元，年增1.07倍，每股純益15.8元，年增1.01倍。
paras_en: Jianshe (3653-TW) has a positive product outlook. Institutional investors note that with the increase in thermal design power (TDP) and worsening chip warpage issues, revenue contribution from the detachable heat spreader (TR Lid) is expected to rise starting next year. Adoption will begin with NVIDIA (NVDA-US) Vera Rubin and Rubin Ultra, boosting ASP and allowing gross margin to improve quarter by quarter, spurring a sharp rise today (the 5th) up to 7,440 TWD, a new historical peak.

Jianshe opened the morning session flat at 6,800 TWD. Although the price briefly turned negative, falling to 6,760 TWD, it quickly recovered and climbed, reaching a intraday high of 7,440 TWD, up more than 9%. By the midday session the price was reported at 7,315 TWD, still more than half a limit‑up move, ranking fourth among the thousand‑dollar stocks, behind Xin Hua (5274‑TW), Chuanhu (2059‑TW) and Chuangyi (3443‑TW).

Institutions say Jianshe expects to begin small‑scale shipments of the TR Lid for testing in Q4 of this year, and if the tests go well, its contribution will grow starting next year. They also point out that the TR Lid’s unit price is several times higher than current products, which will further drive revenue. They forecast next‑year revenue could more than double year‑over‑year, and gross margin has the chance to break the 50% mark.

Jianshe recently announced its self‑reported results: August revenue was NT$3.236 billion, up 91% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$1.079 billion, up 1.01‑fold, and earnings per share (EPS) of NT$7.35, up 95% year‑over‑year. For the second quarter, revenue was NT$7.275 billion, up 40% year‑over‑year, after‑tax net profit was NT$2.318 billion, up 1.07‑fold, and EPS was NT$15.8, up 1.01‑fold.

items.title: 〈台北紡織展〉南亞三大特色產品亮相 聚焦高機能、舒適及創新永續纖維
items.title_en: <Taipei Textile Expo> Nan Ya Showcases Three Signature Products, Focusing on High-Performance, Comfort and Innovative Sustainable Fibers
paras: 南亞(1303-TW)塑膠長期致力研發特殊機能與環保永續纖維產品，今(5)日宣布，將於2026台北紡織展(TITAS)中展出多項創新機能纖維，此次聚焦在防汗漬纖維高消光纖維及TPEE熱塑性聚酯彈性絲，展現南亞在高機能、舒適性、美學及永續材料上的開發成果。
南亞表示，其中防汗漬纖維透過特殊材料設計，能降低流汗時布面汗痕的產生，改善運動及日常穿著時因流汗造成的外觀困擾，同時兼具低光澤、防透視及熱遮蔽效果，適合應用於運動、瑜珈、制服及貼身服飾等產品。高消光纖維則從纖維光澤、細度及斷面設計著手，除保有低光澤、防透視性能外，更兼具獨特觸感及吸濕排汗性，讓機能性纖維不僅著重性能，也能兼顧服飾所重視的質感及舒適性，拓展產品價值。
在永續彈性材料方面，南亞自主開發的熱塑性聚酯彈性絲已正式量產，兼具高彈性與聚酯單一材質優勢，有助於提升紡織品後續回收再利用，目前亦已與多家國際品牌合作開發，另相較於傳統採熔融紡絲製程，無需使用溶劑，並具節能及良好手感等特色，可廣泛應用於運動、瑜珈及休閒服飾等產品。隨著市場對單一材質設計及產品可回收性的重視提升也將成為推動高機能與永續循環的重要產品之一。
此外，南亞此次TITAS將再度攜手日本可樂麗商事株式會社，透過南亞在纖維製造、研發及量產的能力，結合可樂麗在材料技術與市場開發上的經驗，延續雙方在機能纖維、材料技術及市場應用上的合作，推進創新材料由開發階段走向實際商品化。
在長纖產品方面，南亞與可樂麗雙方合作開發機能性易開纖型超細纖維、輕量速乾深染纖維及輕量速乾疏水纖維，本次亦將首度於台灣發表新型涼感速乾纖維，結合涼感、快乾及舒適等特色，回應戶外運動、休閒及高機能服飾對穿著舒適性的需求，雙方合作更進一步延伸至短纖棉應用，持續開發包括高收縮、抗起毛球等機能產品，擴大聚酯材料在服飾及紡織產品上的應用範圍。
南亞表示，此次從防汗漬、低光澤柔和質感、高彈性單一材質，到超細纖維、速乾、疏水及涼感機能開發，將透過今年TITAS展現多元機能纖維創新成果，並持續與國際品牌及材料夥伴合作，推動高機能、舒適與永續材料的市場應用。
paras_en: Nan Ya (1303-TW), a long‑time developer of special‑function and eco‑sustainable fiber products, announced today (the 5th) that it will exhibit several innovative functional fibers at the 2026 Taipei Textile Expo (TITAS). The showcase centers on sweat‑resistant fibers, high‑matte fibers and TPEE thermoplastic polyester elastic yarn, highlighting Nan Ya’s achievements in high‑performance, comfort, aesthetics and sustainable materials.

Nan Ya explained that its sweat‑resistant fiber, designed with special materials, reduces the appearance of sweat stains on fabric, improving the look of athletic and everyday wear when sweating. It also offers low gloss, anti‑see‑through and heat‑shielding properties, making it suitable for sports, yoga, uniforms and close‑fit apparel. The high‑matte fiber is engineered from fiber luster, fineness and cross‑section design; besides low gloss and anti‑see‑through performance, it provides a unique hand feel and moisture‑wicking capability, giving functional fibers both performance and the texture and comfort valued in garments, thereby expanding product value.

Regarding sustainable elastic materials, Nan Ya’s self‑developed thermoplastic polyester elastic yarn has entered full‑scale production. It combines high elasticity with the advantages of a single‑material polyester, facilitating later textile recycling. The yarn is already being co‑developed with several international brands. Compared with traditional melt‑spinning processes, it requires no solvent, saves energy and offers a pleasant hand feel, making it suitable for sports, yoga and leisure apparel. As the market places greater emphasis on single‑material design and product recyclability, this yarn is poised to become a key driver of high‑performance and circular sustainability.

In addition, Nan Ya will again partner with Japan’s Kolon Industries Co., Ltd. at TITAS, leveraging Nan Ya’s fiber manufacturing, R&D and mass‑production capabilities together with Kolon’s material technology and market development expertise. The collaboration will continue the two companies’ joint work on functional fibers, material technologies and market applications, advancing innovative materials from development to commercialisation.

For long‑fiber products, Nan Ya and Kolon have co‑developed functional easy‑open ultra‑fine fibers, lightweight quick‑dry deep‑dyed fibers and lightweight quick‑dry hydrophobic fibers. At this show they will also debut a new cooling quick‑dry fiber in Taiwan, which combines cooling, fast‑drying and comfort features to meet the comfort demands of outdoor, leisure and high‑performance apparel. Their partnership further extends to short‑fiber cotton applications, continuously developing functional products such as high‑shrinkage and anti‑pilling fibers, broadening the use of polyester materials in apparel and textile goods.

Nan Ya said that this year’s TITAS will showcase a wide range of functional fiber innovations—from sweat‑resistant, low‑gloss soft‑hand, high‑elastic single‑material fibers to ultra‑fine, quick‑dry, hydrophobic and cooling functions—while maintaining collaborations with international brands and material partners to promote the market adoption of high‑performance, comfortable and sustainable materials.

items.title: 汽車板廠敬鵬喜迎工業控制電子板新訂單 泰國將有新產能加入
items.title_en: Automotive PCB Maker Jingpeng Welcomes New Industrial‑Control Electronic Board Orders; New Capacity to Come Online in Thailand
paras: 汽車板大廠敬鵬 (2355-TW) 在泰國生產基地的新投資進展順利，法人除看好 2026 年敬鵬的整體營運將回升之外，新廠新產能的加入，加上敬鵬原已立足泰國PCB生產多年的經驗，在2027年的成長表現極受到矚目。
在全球車商需求持穩下，敬鵬2026年上半年營收97.7億元，年增 6.17%，汽車板出貨占比升至 77%，優於2025年的占比平均值的 75%，同時含航太、LEO 板等網通板占比也在 5% 占比水準，法人看好 2026 年敬鵬的整體營運將較去年回升。
敬鵬受惠汽車板市場需求回溫、及跨足工業控制電子板逐漸有成，工業電子控制板並在今年有新取得新訂單入袋業績預估將由今年下半年起走高，同時，敬鵬除在泰國生產基地原廠完成改造投產之外，新建生產大樓的新投資進展順利，預計2027年還有新產能投產，且目前對 CCL成本節節上攀的營運干擾，並已陸續向客戶端反映。
敬鵬 2026 年上半年營收 40.56 億元，毛利率 12.13%，年增0.45個百分點，稅後純益 4.26 億元，年增39.45%，每股純益 1.07元。
雖然國際油價起伏不定，但敬鵬指出，基本的換購需求仍然持穩，帶動敬鵬汽車板的銷售也穩定；另一方面，積極布局工業電子控制、航太、通訊等領域也開始貢獻營收。其中，工業電子控制板並在今年有新取得新訂單入袋，工業用的控制板比重提升快，推估與 AI 的自動化生產推進，造成對工業用板需求增加有關。
敬鵬 2026 年上半年汽車板出貨占比升至 77%，優於去年的占比平均值的 75%，同時含航太、LEO 板等網通板占比也在 5% 占比水準。至於市場關注的敬鵬切入低軌衛星 (LEO) 板與航太板則已出貨並歸類在網通類營收中。
paras_en: Jingpeng (2355‑TW), a major automotive PCB manufacturer, reports smooth progress on its new investment at its Thailand production base. Analysts not only expect Jingpeng’s overall operations to rebound in 2026, but also see the addition of new capacity at the plant—combined with the company’s many years of PCB production experience in Thailand—as a strong growth driver for 2027.

With global automakers’ demand remaining steady, Jingpeng posted revenue of NT$9.77 billion for the first half of 2026, up 6.17% year‑on‑year. The share of automotive PCB shipments rose to 77%, above the 2025 average of 75%. Aerospace, LEO and other networking boards together accounted for about 5% of shipments, reinforcing analysts’ view that Jingpeng’s overall performance will improve over last year.

Benefiting from a rebound in automotive PCB demand and gradual success in industrial‑control electronic boards, Jingpeng expects new orders for industrial control boards to lift earnings from the second half of this year onward. In addition to completing the refurbishment of its existing Thailand plant, the construction of a new production building is progressing well, with new capacity slated to start up in 2027. The company is also addressing rising CCL costs, which have been affecting operations, by communicating with customers.

For the first half of 2026, Jingpeng recorded revenue of NT$4.056 billion, a gross margin of 12.13%—up 0.45 percentage points year‑on‑year—net profit after tax of NT$426 million, up 39.45%, and earnings per share of NT$1.07.

Although international oil prices have been volatile, Jingpeng says the underlying replacement‑vehicle demand remains stable, keeping automotive PCB sales steady. At the same time, its push into industrial‑electronic control, aerospace and communications segments is beginning to contribute to revenue. New industrial‑control board orders secured this year are boosting the share of industrial boards, driven by the automation push linked to AI, which is raising demand for such boards.

In the first half of 2026, automotive PCB shipments accounted for 77% of total output, surpassing last year’s average of 75%, while aerospace, LEO and other networking boards together made up roughly 5% of revenue. The LEO and aerospace boards that have drawn market attention are already shipped and are classified under the networking‑board revenue category.

items.title: 美伊進入「關鍵一週」！是戰是談？美銀分析油價103美元面臨4大情境
paras: 美伊對峙進入關鍵階段。隨著外交談判陷入僵局、美軍持續向中東增兵，美國總統川普近期接連釋放強硬訊號，伊朗則在警告若遭軍事攻擊將發動「更具毀滅性」反擊的同時，仍強調外交大門尚未關閉。
伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araghchi）週日（4日）表示，伊朗仍願透過外交途徑尋求「公正且體面」的解決方案，但若敵方再次採取軍事行動，伊朗將予以比過去「更具毀滅性」的回擊。
川普上週末在白宮外接受媒體訪問時表示，針對伊朗問題，他將做出決定，「要不是走簡單的路，就是走困難的路」，但未說明具體時間表，只表示「你們會看到的」。
與此同時，美國高層近期也密集討論伊朗局勢。
根據《Axios》報導，美國副總統范斯（JD Vance）、國務卿盧比歐（Marco Rubio）、國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）、特使魏科夫（Steve Witkoff）、中央情報局局長拉特克里夫（John Ratcliffe）及參謀首長聯席會議主席凱恩（Dan Caine）上週五在戴維營舉行秘密會議，伊朗局勢及葉門胡塞武裝問題均列入議程。
美銀認為，目前布蘭特原油約每桶103美元的價格，正落在「零星衝突」與「密集交戰」兩種情境之間。
接下來，川普的決定、伊朗透過卡達傳遞的回應、葉門局勢、油輪遭襲情況、伊朗國內壓力，以及宏觀經濟因素，都可能左右油價下一步走向。

川普持續施壓 美軍增兵中東

川普近期不斷對伊朗施加外交壓力。他接受《時代》雜誌專訪時表示，如果美伊無法達成令美國滿意的協議，軍事行動可能在美國期中選舉後恢復。
同日晚間，川普在前往奧克拉荷馬州途中再度向記者表示，伊朗「要不簽署一份非常公平的協議，就不復存在」。
不過，伊朗仍試圖維持談判空間。阿拉格齊表示，伊朗代表團近期赴紐約出席聯合國大會期間，已提出一項旨在化解分歧、結束目前美伊敵對狀態的方案。若美方接受，荷姆茲海峽可在7天內重新開放。
阿拉格齊並稱，美國過去在軍事與外交領域均已遭遇失敗，對伊朗實施的新制裁也注定徒勞無功，呼籲美國選擇「明智理性」的道路。他強調，只有建立在正義與公平基礎上的外交及談判，才是解決問題的途徑。
在外交角力持續之際，美軍也正推進新一輪部署。
《華爾街日報》報導，西奧多·羅斯福號航空母艦打擊群已從聖地牙哥出發，「馬金島」號兩棲戒備群也已啟程，兩支編隊合計搭載逾7000名水兵及約2000名海軍陸戰隊員，預計10月底前後抵達中東。
屆時，美國在伊朗附近將形成3個航母打擊群的部署態勢。根據《彭博》報導，這種兵力集中程度自2003年伊拉克戰爭初期以來未曾出現。
《彭博》此前報導指出，伊朗官員認為，在11月3日期中選舉前達成協議的可能性相當低，選舉後局勢升級的可能性則很高，代表未來一至兩週可能成為期中選舉前最後一段相對可控的談判窗口。

胡塞武裝攻擊延燒 曼德海峽能源通道面臨風險

除了荷姆茲海峽，葉門局勢也讓能源供應面臨另一項風險。
葉門胡塞武裝3日晚間表示，為回應沙烏地阿拉伯對薩那及葉門其他地區發動空襲，胡塞武裝當天使用多枚彈道飛彈及無人機，攻擊位於沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的沙烏地阿美石油公司（Saudi Aramco）目標，並宣稱「成功實現目標」及「命中目標並引發火災」。
另一方面，《Axios》引述兩名美國官員報導指出，沙烏地阿拉伯計畫在未來數日對胡塞武裝發動大規模軍事行動，目標鎖定讓胡塞武裝得以控制曼德海峽的沿海地區。
據報導，相關行動將由葉門政府地面部隊主導，並由沙烏地空軍提供支援，重點攻擊胡塞武裝在沿海地區的戰略據點。
這場衝突同樣涉及能源利益。上月胡塞武裝攻占曼德海峽及約150公里紅海沿岸，而曼德海峽是沙烏地阿拉伯繞過荷姆茲海峽、向西方出口原油的重要替代通道。

美伊談判卡關 荷姆茲海峽重啟受7項條件限制

在談判方面，美伊雙方的歧異仍然明顯。
伊朗議長兼首席談判代表卡利巴夫（Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf）表示，除非伊朗提出的7項條件獲得滿足，否則荷姆茲海峽不會重新開放。他並表示，美國拖延談判及單方面提出要求的時代已經過去。
伊朗提出的7項條件包括解除海上封鎖、歸還遭凍結資產、取消伊朗石油出口制裁、停止以軍事威脅為由採取行動、終止對伊朗及其區域盟友的戰爭、撤離伊朗邊境周邊的美軍，以及賠償戰爭損失並承諾不干涉伊朗核與飛彈能力。
川普此前已拒絕以這些條件為基礎、在7天內重新開放荷姆茲海峽的方案，並認為伊朗的提議「遠遠不夠」。
伊朗方面則表示，將針對美方透過卡達傳遞的方案補充一些意見後再予以回覆。
《路透》引述知情人士指出，美伊目前的主要分歧並不在各項步驟本身，而在於這些步驟應以什麼順序推進。換言之，外交窗口尚未完全關閉，但談判空間正逐步縮小。

油價為何仍站上100美元？高盛：風險溢價未消退

儘管海灣地區的石油出口量已恢復至戰前水準，油價仍維持每桶100美元以上。
高盛大宗商品交易策略師Thomas Evans在週末報告中指出，供應面的緊張情勢雖已緩解，但市場風險溢價並未消失，期貨價格與價差仍維持在近期高位。
Evans估計，目前期現貨價差約為每桶20至25美元。他並警告，真正的風險在於，如果遭到攻擊導致海灣石油出貨量在數日內再次跌至50%以下，目前的供應緩衝將大幅縮小，屆時庫存與油價可能出現大幅跳升。
《彭博》引述 Energy Aspects 數據指出，全球石油庫存自3月以來已減少逾4億桶，目前約43億桶的總量處於5年低位。波斯灣至中國航線的油輪租金也已突破每日120萬美元。
此外，自上週四以來，阿曼南部海域至少發生4起油輪遭襲事件。若英國海事貿易行動組織（UKMTO）持續以目前頻率發布警告，仰賴「暗線出口」維持的供應恢復可能面臨更大壓力。
高盛全球石油及產品交易聯席主管Jerome Dortmans表示，伊朗擁有顯著干擾荷姆茲海峽石油出貨的能力，而美國向該地區增派第3個航母打擊群及1萬名海軍陸戰隊員，「絕對不是伊朗可以無視的訊號」。

油價面臨4種情境 103美元成為關鍵分界

在地緣政治風險升溫之際，美銀大宗商品團隊已將2026年下半年布蘭特原油基準預測從每桶83美元上調至95美元，理由是「零星衝突可能延續至年底」。
目前布蘭特約每桶103美元的價格，正處於零星衝突與密集交戰兩種情境之間。美銀提出4種可能走向：

達成協議、恢復諒解備忘錄：機率較低，荷姆茲海峽出貨量恢復至每日逾1000萬桶，2026年下半年布蘭特均價為83美元。
維持零星衝突：屬於基準情境，間歇性出貨約每日500萬桶，2026年下半年布蘭特均價為95美元。
恢復密集交戰：機率較低，布蘭特油價升至每桶120美元。
戰火波及能源基礎設施：屬於尾部風險，布蘭特均價可能達每桶150美元甚至更高。


根據美銀分析，接下來市場將密切觀察6項訊號，共同決定油價落在哪個情境區間：
首先是川普的「決定」。過去5天，他已3度釋放「你們會看到的」訊號，戴維營會議是否形成實質決定，以及是否有官方訊息對外公布，將成為本週最重要的觀察焦點。
其次是伊朗透過卡達傳遞的回應。伊朗方面表示仍需補充意見，雙方真正的分歧則集中在各項步驟的推進順序，這項僵局能否出現鬆動，將影響談判能否進入實質階段。
第三是葉門戰場發展。胡塞武裝正向塔茲至亞丁之間的最後一條公路推進，沙烏地阿拉伯針對曼德海峽沿岸的軍事行動是否取得進展，以及利雅德或胡賴斯是否遭到確認性攻擊，都將影響第二條能源通道的安全預期。
第四是阿曼南部油輪遭襲情況。自上週四以來已有至少4艘油輪遭到攻擊，若 UKMTO 持續發布相關警告，供應恢復可能受到實質衝擊。
第五是伊朗內部壓力，包括石油部長職位懸缺、里亞爾匯率跌至270萬兌1美元，以及通膨率逼近90%，都可能成為觀察德黑蘭談判立場的重要變數。
第六則是宏觀經濟因素。聯準會將於週三公布 FOMC 會議紀要，同期還有10年期及30年期美債標售；中國結束假期後也將於週四恢復交易，並面臨10月燃料出口暫停政策。高盛指出，目前油價與利率的聯動程度遠高於正常水準，因此宏觀因素同樣不容忽視。
Chatham House 研究員Aniseh Bassiri Tabrizi表示，雙方普遍希望達成協議，但彼此正逐漸走向更大的分歧。
在每桶103美元的油價背後，市場目前反映的仍是零星衝突延續的情境，但隨著美伊談判、軍事部署及葉門戰事同步發展，戰爭與外交談判之間的界線，本週可能進一步明朗。

items.title: 非農爆冷也救不了！美元、美債殖利率持續施壓金價  4000美元大關保衛戰本周開始？
items.title_en: Even a Cold Nonfarm Payroll Can't Save It! Dollar and US Treasury Yields Keep Pressuring Gold; $4,000 Barrier Defense Starts This Week?
paras: 今(5)日亞洲早盤，現貨黃金狹幅震盪於每盎司4144.52美元附近，4000美元關卡能否守住，將成為本週黃金多空決戰的焦點。
國際金價上周五(2日)再度收跌金價，盤中一度因美國9月非農就業數據大幅低於預期而飆逾1%至4226.51美元，但終場仍跌0.9%至4139.28美元，單周下跌約3.4%，美國COMEX期金亦收黑1%，結算價報4162.30美元。黃金漲勢被美元反彈和美債殖利率高企壓抑，所有貴金屬上周均下跌，華爾街情緒明顯轉空，散戶也首次失去7月底以來的看漲多數。
美國9月僅新增29000個就業崗位，薪資較去年同期成長放緩至3%。理論上，疲軟的就業數據會減輕Fed升息壓力，提升黃金相對於生息資產的吸引力，但金價上周依舊收跌，足以看出美元與債券市場帶來的強大壓制。金價想要走出有力反彈行情，需要美元與實際殖利率同步下檔。
與此同時，在金價處於歷史高點的背景下，亞洲多國開始挖掘本土黃金生產價值，推動黃金資源自主發展。
外媒最新報導指出，印尼打算對原生及半成品黃金徵收出口稅，稅率根據國際金價設定在7.5%至15%之間，目的是推動黃金在本國完成精煉加工。
南韓亦重啟實體黃金收購計畫，聯合本土精煉企業採購原本會出口的黃金，在國內充實儲備，降低對國際黃金市場的依賴。
此外，亞洲大國持續增持官方黃金儲備，將黃金視為戰略資源，不斷完善國內黃金供應鏈管控。新加坡與香港正擴大區域黃金基礎設施，新加坡搭建央行黃金倉儲體系，香港推出本地黃金清算試點，這類措施將長期有利於實體黃金需，提升區域黃金供給自主能力。
今年8月，國際金價迎來一波強勢上漲後，在4700美元附近遇阻回落，這一信號值得警惕。只要金價維持在4000美元上方，長期看漲結構就能夠保留，市場也在4300美元下方形成新的支撐區域。
當前黃金市場多空博弈僵持，一方面有穩定的亞洲大國需求及避險資金支撐，另一方面高油價、強勢美元和Fed再度緊縮貨幣政策的風險持續施壓。在貨幣政策壓力緩解前，金價想再度衝擊4700美元難度較高。
paras_en: In today’s (5th) Asian early session, spot gold was trading narrowly around $4,144.52 per ounce, and whether the $4,000 level can hold will be the focal point of this week’s gold bull‑bear showdown.

International gold prices fell again on Friday (the 2nd). During the session the price briefly surged more than 1% to $4,226.51 after September US non‑farm payrolls came in far below expectations, but closed down 0.9% at $4,139.28, a weekly drop of about 3.4%. US COMEX futures also closed lower, down 1%, with a settlement price of $4,162.30. The gold rally was suppressed by a rebounding dollar and high US Treasury yields, and all precious metals fell last week. Wall Street sentiment turned clearly bearish, and retail investors lost their bullish majority for the first time since late July.

September added only 29,000 jobs in the US and wages grew more slowly to 3% year‑on‑year. In theory, weak employment data should ease Fed rate‑hike pressure and make gold more attractive relative to interest‑bearing assets, but gold still closed lower last week, underscoring the strong drag from the dollar and bond markets. For gold to launch a solid rebound, both the dollar and real yields need to move lower together.
At the same time, with gold prices at historic highs, several Asian countries are beginning to tap the value of domestic gold production and promote self‑sufficient gold resource development.

Foreign media reports that Indonesia plans to levy an export tax on primary and semi‑finished gold, with rates set between 7.5% and 15% based on international gold prices, aiming to encourage refining of gold within the country.

South Korea has also revived a physical gold purchase program, partnering with domestic refiners to buy gold that would otherwise be exported, bolstering domestic reserves and reducing reliance on the international gold market.

Moreover, major Asian nations continue to increase official gold reserves, treating gold as a strategic resource and constantly improving domestic gold supply‑chain controls. Singapore and Hong Kong are expanding regional gold infrastructure—Singapore is building a central‑bank gold storage system, while Hong Kong has launched a local gold clearing pilot—measures that will long‑term benefit physical gold demand and enhance regional supply autonomy.

In August this year, after a strong rally, international gold prices stalled near $4,700 and pulled back, a signal worth watching. As long as gold stays above $4,000, the long‑term bullish structure can be preserved, and the market is forming a new support zone below $4,300.

The current gold market is locked in a stalemate: on one side there is steady demand from major Asian economies and hedge‑fund flows, while on the other side high oil prices, a strong dollar and the Fed’s renewed tightening pose ongoing pressure. Until monetary‑policy pressures ease, it will be difficult for gold to retake the $4,700 level.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉大盤直逼5萬點！00406A上演秒填息 22萬股東笑了
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Market Near 50,000 Points! 00406A Executes Instant Dividend Fill, 220,000 Shareholders Cheer
paras: 台股今(5)日開盤大漲逾千點，創下新高，直逼 5 萬點大關。熱門 ETF 主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)同日進行除息，受惠於大盤強勁上漲動能，開盤即順利完成填息，盤中漲逾 3%。根據統計，該檔ETF上周規模增加19.7億元，成長3.2%，總規模達630億元，穩居主動式ETF第四大。同時，受益人數在一周內增加約3.8萬人，總人數突破22萬人，顯示投資人關注度持續升溫。
法人表示，目前市場資金焦點持續圍繞在AI資本支出擴張及企業獲利成長題材。隨著全球雲端服務供應商持續加碼資料中心建設，AI相關需求不僅未見放緩，反而持續向上游設備、材料、載板及記憶體等領域擴散，帶動整體產業景氣延續成長循環。
投資專家表示，第四季向來是台股傳統旺季，歷史經驗顯示股市表現通常相對亮眼。距離年底仍有近三個月時間，在AI需求強勁、企業獲利持續成長及外資回流帶動下，台股仍具續創新高機會。
相較之下，部分傳統高股息ETF因電子股持股比重偏低，若市場主流資金持續聚焦電子與AI族群，在成長性方面可能不如一般市值型或主動式台股ETF。00406A除了提供配息機制外，約有八成持股布局於成長型企業，讓投資人得以兼顧資本成長與現金流需求，也因此成為近期市場熱門標的之一。
展望後市，主動中信台灣收益ETF經理人張書廷表示，第四季是電子產業出貨旺季，加上企業法說會將陸續登場，尤其是台積電法說在15日登場，若持續上修獲利展望，可望進一步提升市場信心，帶動資金追價意願。法人普遍認為，在AI產業趨勢、企業獲利成長及外資偏多操作的支撐下，台股中長期多頭格局仍未改變。
不過，投資人仍需留意，短期指數漲幅已大，過程中可能受到國際政經事件、利率政策變化及獲利了結賣壓干擾，市場波動難免加劇。然而回歸基本面來看，AI仍是目前最具確定性的成長主軸。在資本支出持續擴張、產業供需結構改善，以及企業獲利預期不斷上修的帶動下，半導體、先進封裝、ABF載板、PCB、高速傳輸及AI伺服器供應鏈等族群，預料仍將是第四季市場資金布局的重要焦點。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks opened today (the 5th) with a surge of over 1,000 points, hitting a new high and edging close to the 50,000‑point milestone. The popular active ETF China Trust Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) went ex‑dividend on the same day; buoyed by the market’s strong upward momentum it promptly filled the dividend gap at the open and rose more than 3% intraday. Statistics show the ETF’s assets grew by NT$19.7 billion last week, a 3.2% increase, bringing total assets to NT$630 billion, keeping it the fourth‑largest active ETF. Meanwhile, the number of beneficiaries rose by about 38,000 in a week, surpassing 220,000 overall, indicating growing investor interest.

Institutional investors said the market’s capital focus remains on AI‑related capital‑expenditure expansion and corporate earnings growth. As global cloud service providers continue to invest in data‑center construction, AI demand has not slowed; instead it is spreading upstream to equipment, materials, substrates and memory, sustaining a growth cycle for the whole industry.

Investment experts noted that Q4 has traditionally been a strong season for Taiwan equities, with historical data showing relatively bright market performance. With nearly three months left in the year, strong AI demand, ongoing corporate profit growth and foreign‑capital inflows give the market further upside potential to set new highs.

By contrast, some traditional high‑dividend ETFs hold a relatively low proportion of electronics stocks. If mainstream capital continues to gravitate toward electronics and AI themes, their growth prospects may lag behind those of broader market‑cap or active Taiwan equity ETFs. In addition to its dividend mechanism, 00406A allocates about 80% of its holdings to growth‑oriented companies, allowing investors to balance capital appreciation with cash‑flow needs, making it a recent market favorite.

Looking ahead, active ETF manager Zhang Shuting of China Trust Taiwan Yield said Q4 is the shipping peak season for the electronics sector, and corporate earnings calls will roll out, notably TSMC’s on the 15th. If profit outlooks keep being revised upward, market confidence could rise further, spurring capital chasing price gains. Institutional players generally believe that, supported by AI trends, earnings growth and net‑foreign‑investment bias, the medium‑to‑long‑term bullish stance on Taiwan stocks remains unchanged.

Nevertheless, investors should remain cautious: the short‑term index rally is already sizable and could be disrupted by international political‑economic events, interest‑rate policy shifts, and profit‑taking pressure, which may heighten volatility. From a fundamentals perspective, AI remains the most certain growth driver. Ongoing cap‑ex expansion, improved industry supply‑demand balance, and continual upward revisions of earnings forecasts are expected to keep semiconductor, advanced packaging, ABF substrates, PCB, high‑speed transmission and AI‑server supply‑chain stocks as key funding targets in Q4.

items.title: 衝破70K大關！日經225狂飆逾1700點  美股期、黃金、白銀、比特幣全面拉升
items.title_en: Breaking the 70K Barrier! Nikkei 225 Soars Over 1,700 Points; US Futures, Gold, Silver, and Bitcoin All Rally
paras: 亞洲股市周一(5日)早盤風險情緒回暖，日股、貴金屬、加密貨幣同步走升，日經225指數大漲1728點、漲幅2.53%，美股三大期貨指數亦小幅走高，現貨黃金站上4158美元、白銀漲破61美元，比特幣攀漲近1.8%，主要因為市場認為美國9月就業遠遜預期，讓Fed本月中再度升息預期降溫，資金回流風險資產。
日股周一由半導體與AI供應鏈領攻，瑞薩電子漲逾7%，東京電子漲逾5%，愛德萬測試漲逾4%，東京精密、科意半導體、羅姆、軟銀等漲超3%，因美光最新財報優於預期，提振全球記憶體與AI伺服器鏈，加上外資加速回補亞太股市及日本資料中心與電力建設題材發酵。
外媒最新報導指出，日本擬以民間投資推動約1400億美元計畫，加速AI資料中心落地，進一步強化半導體與電力設備需求預期。
日本電力巨頭JERA、戴爾及英國AI基礎設施企業Rhaelm近日達成協議，將在東京附近投資150億美元，建造一座400兆瓦的資料中心。
JERA全球總裁金井幸雄表示，三家企業打算在五年內建成總規模3-4GW的AI資料中心配套燃氣發電基礎設施。「核心關鍵字是快速供電能力。」
JERA每年可交易3500萬噸液化天然氣，可為電站提供燃料。根據金井幸雄估算，1GW算力配套基建的造價在350億至450億美元之間。按此推算，建成上述規模基礎設施的總投入約需1400億美元。
日本本土擁有NTT資料、軟銀等大型資料中心營運商，黑石集團也打算未來數年在日本投入300億美元佈局相關業務。
paras_en: Asian markets on Monday (the 5th) saw risk sentiment improve in early trading, with Japanese equities, precious metals and cryptocurrencies all climbing. The Nikkei 225 jumped 1,728 points, up 2.53%, while the three major US futures indices edged higher. Spot gold rose above $4,158, silver broke $61, and Bitcoin gained nearly 1.8%, mainly because the market believes September US employment data will fall short of expectations, cooling expectations of another Fed rate hike this month and prompting a flow of capital back into risk assets.

Japanese stocks on Monday were led by the semiconductor and AI supply chain, with Renesas Electronics up more than 7%, Tokyo Electron up over 5%, Advantest up more than 4%, and Tokyo Seimitsu, Kioxia, Rohm, SoftBank and others gaining over 3%. The rally was fueled by Micron’s better‑than‑expected earnings, which lifted global memory and AI server chains, alongside accelerating foreign‑fund repurchases in Asia‑Pacific equities and growing interest in Japanese data‑center and power‑construction themes.

Foreign media reports say Japan plans to use private investment to drive a roughly $140 billion program that will accelerate the rollout of AI data centers, further strengthening expectations for semiconductor and power‑equipment demand.
Japanese power giant JERA, Dell and UK AI‑infrastructure firm Rhaelm recently reached an agreement to invest $15 billion near Tokyo to build a 400‑megawatt data center.

JERA Global President Yukio Kanai said the three companies aim to develop AI data‑center supporting gas‑power infrastructure with a total capacity of 3‑4 GW within five years. “The core keyword is rapid power‑supply capability,” he said.

JERA can trade 35 million tonnes of liquefied natural gas each year, providing fuel for power plants. Kanai estimates that the infrastructure to support 1 GW of compute power will cost between $35 billion and $45 billion. By that calculation, the total investment needed to build the aforementioned infrastructure would be about $140 billion.

Japan’s domestic operators such as NTT Data and SoftBank run large data‑center businesses, and Blackstone also plans to commit $30 billion over the coming years in Japan to develop related operations.

items.title: 費半領漲！海外主動式ETF悄獲資金青睞 00411A月漲近13%奪冠
items.title_en: Fee Half Leads Gains! Overseas Active ETFs Quietly Attract Funds; 00411A Up Nearly 13% in a Month Takes the Crown
paras: 9 月非農就業低於預期，市場升息預期降溫，激勵上周五費半走強，連帶今(5)日台積電(2330-TW)一開盤就飆上2580元新天價，加權指數劍指5萬點大關。大盤衝高之際，主動式ETF市場上漲主力軍卻悄悄換人當，近一個月來漲幅領先的全是海外主動式ETF，主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)以月漲幅逼近13%，擠下一票主動式ETF老前輩登上冠軍，今天盤中00411A更刷新自身歷史新高價，展現領漲氣勢。
不同於上半年全球資金聚焦於亞股市場，隨著近來費半走勢反彈上攻，資金也開始顯著輪動。根據CMoney統計，近一個月費半指數大漲超過雙位數，表現遠優於日、韓、台等亞股；同樣的現象也發生在主動式ETF中，近一個月來績效前十名中，前七名都由海外主動式ETF包辦，8月底才掛牌的00411A月漲幅高達12.7%，拿下漲幅第一名。
除了00411A月漲幅超過雙位數外，近一個月來表現亮眼的還有主動元大AI新經濟(00990A-TW)、主動群益美國增長(00997A-TW)，及主動統一全球創新(00988A-TW)，這三檔月漲幅約在11%-10%之間。第五名則是主動安聯美國科技(00402A-TW)，月漲幅約9%。
而一向是市場寵兒的台股主動式ETF，近一個月漲幅冠軍則是主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)，月漲幅直逼8%。其次則是主動富邦台灣龍耀(00405A-TW)、主動台新龍頭成長(00986A-TW)，漲幅約7%左右。
展望後市，主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)經理人郭智偉表示，長線而言，美國經濟基本面良好，AI推動企業獲利續揚，且AI應用也有望步入快速成長期，股市長線多頭態勢不變。但在美國期中大選前，股市震盪難免，加上全球利率環境變化及地緣政治風險等短期雜音干擾，若股市出現拉回修正，應視為逢低布局機會。後續將持續關注AI及能源基建、AI軟體自動駕駛、太空經濟及量子運算等領域的投資布局機會。

paras_en: In September, non‑farm payrolls came in below expectations, cooling expectations of further rate hikes. This helped the FEI Half‑index rally last Friday, and today (the 5th) TSMC (2330‑TW) opened at a new high of NT$2,580, pushing the weighted index toward the 50,000‑point mark. While the broad market surged, the leading drivers in the active‑ETF space quietly changed: over the past month, overseas active ETFs have posted the biggest gains, with Active UniFrontier Technology (00411A‑TW) posting a near‑13% monthly increase, displacing a veteran active ETF from the top spot. During intraday trading, 00411A even set a new historical high, showcasing its leading‑gain momentum.

Unlike the first half of the year when global capital was focused on Asian equities, the recent rebound in the FEI Half‑index has prompted a noticeable rotation of funds. According to CMoney data, the FEI Half‑index has surged by double‑digit percentages over the past month, outperforming Asian markets such as Japan, Korea and Taiwan. The same pattern appears in active ETFs: among the top ten performers over the past month, the first seven are all overseas active ETFs, and the newly listed 00411A posted a 12.7% monthly gain, ranking first in percentage increase.

In addition to 00411A’s double‑digit monthly rise, other standout performers over the past month include Active Yuanta AI New Economy (00990A‑TW), Active Cathay US Growth (00997A‑TW) and Active Uni Global Innovation (00988A‑TW), each posting monthly gains of roughly 11%‑10%. The fifth‑place spot goes to Active Allianz US Technology (00402A‑TW) with a monthly increase of about 9%.

The traditionally favored Taiwanese active ETFs saw the top monthly performer be Active Uni Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW), which nearly hit an 8% gain. It is followed by Active Fubon Taiwan Dragon Shine (00405A‑TW) and Active Taishin Leading Growth (00986A‑TW), both up around 7%.

Looking ahead, Active UniFrontier Technology (00411A‑TW) portfolio manager Guo Zhi‑wei said that in the long run the U.S. economy’s fundamentals remain strong, AI is driving corporate earnings higher, and AI applications are likely to enter a rapid growth phase, keeping the long‑term market bullish. However, ahead of the U.S. mid‑term elections, market volatility is inevitable, and short‑term noise from global interest‑rate shifts and geopolitical risks could trigger pull‑backs, which should be seen as buying opportunities on dips. The team will continue to monitor investment opportunities in AI, energy infrastructure, AI software for autonomous driving, space economy and quantum computing.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉健策展望穩健毛利率逐季增 衝7440元再創歷史新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Jianshe Outlook Steady Gross Margin Increases Quarterly, Surges to 7,440 TWD Setting New Historical High
paras: 健策(3653-TW)產品展望正面，法人指出，由於熱設計功耗(TDP)提高，加上晶片翹曲問題進一步加劇，預期明年起可拆式均熱片(TR Lid)的營收貢獻將提高，並從輝達(NVDA-US)Vera Rubin及Rubin Ultra開始導入，帶動ASP提升，毛利率表現可望逐季增溫，激勵健策今(5)日漲勢凌厲，衝上7440元續寫歷史新天價。
健策早盤以6800元開平盤，雖盤中一度翻黑跌至6760元，不過隨後翻紅走高，盤中最高衝上7440元，漲幅超過9%，截至午盤，股價暫報7315元，仍大漲逾半根停板，位居千金股第4名，僅次於信驊(5274-TW)、川湖(2059-TW)以及創意(3443-TW)。
法人表示，健策預計今年第四季將開始小量出貨TR Lid進行測試，若後續測試順利，貢獻度將在明年開始成長。法人並指出，TR Lid單價較現在高出數倍，將進一步帶動營收表現，預估明年營收可望年增逾1倍，毛利率也有機會突破50%。
健策日前公告自結，8月營收32.36億元，年增91%，稅後純益10.79億元，年增1.01倍，每股純益7.35%，年增95%。第二季營收72.75億元，年增40%，稅後純益23.18億元，年增1.07倍，每股純益15.8元，年增1.01倍。
paras_en: Jianshe (3653-TW) has a positive product outlook. Institutional investors note that with the increase in thermal design power (TDP) and worsening chip warpage issues, revenue contribution from the detachable heat spreader (TR Lid) is expected to rise starting next year. Adoption will begin with NVIDIA (NVDA-US) Vera Rubin and Rubin Ultra, boosting ASP and allowing gross margin to improve quarter by quarter, spurring a sharp rise today (the 5th) up to 7,440 TWD, a new historical peak.

Jianshe opened the morning session flat at 6,800 TWD. Although the price briefly turned negative, falling to 6,760 TWD, it quickly recovered and climbed, reaching a intraday high of 7,440 TWD, up more than 9%. By the midday session the price was reported at 7,315 TWD, still more than half a limit‑up move, ranking fourth among the thousand‑dollar stocks, behind Xin Hua (5274‑TW), Chuanhu (2059‑TW) and Chuangyi (3443‑TW).

Institutions say Jianshe expects to begin small‑scale shipments of the TR Lid for testing in Q4 of this year, and if the tests go well, its contribution will grow starting next year. They also point out that the TR Lid’s unit price is several times higher than current products, which will further drive revenue. They forecast next‑year revenue could more than double year‑over‑year, and gross margin has the chance to break the 50% mark.

Jianshe recently announced its self‑reported results: August revenue was NT$3.236 billion, up 91% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$1.079 billion, up 1.01‑fold, and earnings per share (EPS) of NT$7.35, up 95% year‑over‑year. For the second quarter, revenue was NT$7.275 billion, up 40% year‑over‑year, after‑tax net profit was NT$2.318 billion, up 1.07‑fold, and EPS was NT$15.8, up 1.01‑fold.

items.title: 〈台北紡織展〉南亞三大特色產品亮相 聚焦高機能、舒適及創新永續纖維
items.title_en: <Taipei Textile Expo> Nan Ya Showcases Three Signature Products, Focusing on High-Performance, Comfort and Innovative Sustainable Fibers
paras: 南亞(1303-TW)塑膠長期致力研發特殊機能與環保永續纖維產品，今(5)日宣布，將於2026台北紡織展(TITAS)中展出多項創新機能纖維，此次聚焦在防汗漬纖維高消光纖維及TPEE熱塑性聚酯彈性絲，展現南亞在高機能、舒適性、美學及永續材料上的開發成果。
南亞表示，其中防汗漬纖維透過特殊材料設計，能降低流汗時布面汗痕的產生，改善運動及日常穿著時因流汗造成的外觀困擾，同時兼具低光澤、防透視及熱遮蔽效果，適合應用於運動、瑜珈、制服及貼身服飾等產品。高消光纖維則從纖維光澤、細度及斷面設計著手，除保有低光澤、防透視性能外，更兼具獨特觸感及吸濕排汗性，讓機能性纖維不僅著重性能，也能兼顧服飾所重視的質感及舒適性，拓展產品價值。
在永續彈性材料方面，南亞自主開發的熱塑性聚酯彈性絲已正式量產，兼具高彈性與聚酯單一材質優勢，有助於提升紡織品後續回收再利用，目前亦已與多家國際品牌合作開發，另相較於傳統採熔融紡絲製程，無需使用溶劑，並具節能及良好手感等特色，可廣泛應用於運動、瑜珈及休閒服飾等產品。隨著市場對單一材質設計及產品可回收性的重視提升也將成為推動高機能與永續循環的重要產品之一。
此外，南亞此次TITAS將再度攜手日本可樂麗商事株式會社，透過南亞在纖維製造、研發及量產的能力，結合可樂麗在材料技術與市場開發上的經驗，延續雙方在機能纖維、材料技術及市場應用上的合作，推進創新材料由開發階段走向實際商品化。
在長纖產品方面，南亞與可樂麗雙方合作開發機能性易開纖型超細纖維、輕量速乾深染纖維及輕量速乾疏水纖維，本次亦將首度於台灣發表新型涼感速乾纖維，結合涼感、快乾及舒適等特色，回應戶外運動、休閒及高機能服飾對穿著舒適性的需求，雙方合作更進一步延伸至短纖棉應用，持續開發包括高收縮、抗起毛球等機能產品，擴大聚酯材料在服飾及紡織產品上的應用範圍。
南亞表示，此次從防汗漬、低光澤柔和質感、高彈性單一材質，到超細纖維、速乾、疏水及涼感機能開發，將透過今年TITAS展現多元機能纖維創新成果，並持續與國際品牌及材料夥伴合作，推動高機能、舒適與永續材料的市場應用。
paras_en: Nan Ya (1303-TW), a long‑time developer of special‑function and eco‑sustainable fiber products, announced today (the 5th) that it will exhibit several innovative functional fibers at the 2026 Taipei Textile Expo (TITAS). The showcase centers on sweat‑resistant fibers, high‑matte fibers and TPEE thermoplastic polyester elastic yarn, highlighting Nan Ya’s achievements in high‑performance, comfort, aesthetics and sustainable materials.

Nan Ya explained that its sweat‑resistant fiber, designed with special materials, reduces the appearance of sweat stains on fabric, improving the look of athletic and everyday wear when sweating. It also offers low gloss, anti‑see‑through and heat‑shielding properties, making it suitable for sports, yoga, uniforms and close‑fit apparel. The high‑matte fiber is engineered from fiber luster, fineness and cross‑section design; besides low gloss and anti‑see‑through performance, it provides a unique hand feel and moisture‑wicking capability, giving functional fibers both performance and the texture and comfort valued in garments, thereby expanding product value.

Regarding sustainable elastic materials, Nan Ya’s self‑developed thermoplastic polyester elastic yarn has entered full‑scale production. It combines high elasticity with the advantages of a single‑material polyester, facilitating later textile recycling. The yarn is already being co‑developed with several international brands. Compared with traditional melt‑spinning processes, it requires no solvent, saves energy and offers a pleasant hand feel, making it suitable for sports, yoga and leisure apparel. As the market places greater emphasis on single‑material design and product recyclability, this yarn is poised to become a key driver of high‑performance and circular sustainability.

In addition, Nan Ya will again partner with Japan’s Kolon Industries Co., Ltd. at TITAS, leveraging Nan Ya’s fiber manufacturing, R&D and mass‑production capabilities together with Kolon’s material technology and market development expertise. The collaboration will continue the two companies’ joint work on functional fibers, material technologies and market applications, advancing innovative materials from development to commercialisation.

For long‑fiber products, Nan Ya and Kolon have co‑developed functional easy‑open ultra‑fine fibers, lightweight quick‑dry deep‑dyed fibers and lightweight quick‑dry hydrophobic fibers. At this show they will also debut a new cooling quick‑dry fiber in Taiwan, which combines cooling, fast‑drying and comfort features to meet the comfort demands of outdoor, leisure and high‑performance apparel. Their partnership further extends to short‑fiber cotton applications, continuously developing functional products such as high‑shrinkage and anti‑pilling fibers, broadening the use of polyester materials in apparel and textile goods.

Nan Ya said that this year’s TITAS will showcase a wide range of functional fiber innovations—from sweat‑resistant, low‑gloss soft‑hand, high‑elastic single‑material fibers to ultra‑fine, quick‑dry, hydrophobic and cooling functions—while maintaining collaborations with international brands and material partners to promote the market adoption of high‑performance, comfortable and sustainable materials.

items.title: 汽車板廠敬鵬喜迎工業控制電子板新訂單 泰國將有新產能加入
items.title_en: Automotive PCB Maker Jingpeng Welcomes New Industrial‑Control Electronic Board Orders; New Capacity to Come Online in Thailand
paras: 汽車板大廠敬鵬 (2355-TW) 在泰國生產基地的新投資進展順利，法人除看好 2026 年敬鵬的整體營運將回升之外，新廠新產能的加入，加上敬鵬原已立足泰國PCB生產多年的經驗，在2027年的成長表現極受到矚目。
在全球車商需求持穩下，敬鵬2026年上半年營收97.7億元，年增 6.17%，汽車板出貨占比升至 77%，優於2025年的占比平均值的 75%，同時含航太、LEO 板等網通板占比也在 5% 占比水準，法人看好 2026 年敬鵬的整體營運將較去年回升。
敬鵬受惠汽車板市場需求回溫、及跨足工業控制電子板逐漸有成，工業電子控制板並在今年有新取得新訂單入袋業績預估將由今年下半年起走高，同時，敬鵬除在泰國生產基地原廠完成改造投產之外，新建生產大樓的新投資進展順利，預計2027年還有新產能投產，且目前對 CCL成本節節上攀的營運干擾，並已陸續向客戶端反映。
敬鵬 2026 年上半年營收 40.56 億元，毛利率 12.13%，年增0.45個百分點，稅後純益 4.26 億元，年增39.45%，每股純益 1.07元。
雖然國際油價起伏不定，但敬鵬指出，基本的換購需求仍然持穩，帶動敬鵬汽車板的銷售也穩定；另一方面，積極布局工業電子控制、航太、通訊等領域也開始貢獻營收。其中，工業電子控制板並在今年有新取得新訂單入袋，工業用的控制板比重提升快，推估與 AI 的自動化生產推進，造成對工業用板需求增加有關。
敬鵬 2026 年上半年汽車板出貨占比升至 77%，優於去年的占比平均值的 75%，同時含航太、LEO 板等網通板占比也在 5% 占比水準。至於市場關注的敬鵬切入低軌衛星 (LEO) 板與航太板則已出貨並歸類在網通類營收中。
paras_en: Jingpeng (2355‑TW), a major automotive PCB manufacturer, reports smooth progress on its new investment at its Thailand production base. Analysts not only expect Jingpeng’s overall operations to rebound in 2026, but also see the addition of new capacity at the plant—combined with the company’s many years of PCB production experience in Thailand—as a strong growth driver for 2027.

With global automakers’ demand remaining steady, Jingpeng posted revenue of NT$9.77 billion for the first half of 2026, up 6.17% year‑on‑year. The share of automotive PCB shipments rose to 77%, above the 2025 average of 75%. Aerospace, LEO and other networking boards together accounted for about 5% of shipments, reinforcing analysts’ view that Jingpeng’s overall performance will improve over last year.

Benefiting from a rebound in automotive PCB demand and gradual success in industrial‑control electronic boards, Jingpeng expects new orders for industrial control boards to lift earnings from the second half of this year onward. In addition to completing the refurbishment of its existing Thailand plant, the construction of a new production building is progressing well, with new capacity slated to start up in 2027. The company is also addressing rising CCL costs, which have been affecting operations, by communicating with customers.

For the first half of 2026, Jingpeng recorded revenue of NT$4.056 billion, a gross margin of 12.13%—up 0.45 percentage points year‑on‑year—net profit after tax of NT$426 million, up 39.45%, and earnings per share of NT$1.07.

Although international oil prices have been volatile, Jingpeng says the underlying replacement‑vehicle demand remains stable, keeping automotive PCB sales steady. At the same time, its push into industrial‑electronic control, aerospace and communications segments is beginning to contribute to revenue. New industrial‑control board orders secured this year are boosting the share of industrial boards, driven by the automation push linked to AI, which is raising demand for such boards.

In the first half of 2026, automotive PCB shipments accounted for 77% of total output, surpassing last year’s average of 75%, while aerospace, LEO and other networking boards together made up roughly 5% of revenue. The LEO and aerospace boards that have drawn market attention are already shipped and are classified under the networking‑board revenue category.

paras: 2026年10月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 豐達科2024年曾受波音拖累營運放緩，2025年隨交機回穩復甦，2026年在SPS轉單、產能滿載與馬來西亞新廠投產帶動下，營收屢創新高。

(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
需求不是問題，供給才是真正瓶頸

但公司明確表示2026年產能已達滿載，既有訂單交付優先、新件暫緩，顯示需求再強，沒有產能就無法轉化為實際營收。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
馬來西亞新廠成續航力關鍵，M3已試產、M2要到2027年底才完工
M3廠第三季已取得使用執照，年底進駐設備並小量試產，以扣件為主；M2廠主攻機加件，預計2027年第四季才完工。
這代表2026下半年到2027年的成長斜率，幾乎全押在既有廠區放量與M3試產爬坡，2027年之前並無大規模新增產能，資本支出因此維持高檔，屬於先砸錢、後收成的時間差。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
毛利率先蹲後跳，已重返近30%高檔

風險提醒：航太客戶集中度偏高是雙面刃

items.title: 晶豪科(3006)產能幾乎沒增加，9月營收卻年增470%！第三季暴增59%，關鍵全在記憶體漲價
items.title_en: Jinghao Technology (3006) Shows Almost No Capacity Increase Yet September Revenue Jumps 470% YoY! Q3 Surges 59% Driven by Memory Price Hikes
paras: 2026年10月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 晶豪科(3006-TW)公布9月營收74.61億元，雖較8月歷史高點減少5.61%，但仍較去年同期大增470.23%；累計前9月營收433.63億元，年增343.91%。
進一步計算，晶豪科(3006-TW)第三季營收約221.50億元，較第二季的139.46億元大增58.8%，顯示記憶體缺貨與報價上漲，持續推升公司營收規模。
不過，這波成長最值得注意的地方是，晶豪科(3006-TW)出貨量並未同步增加。公司在3月法說會中指出，2026年代工產能預估大致維持平盤，多數營收成長將來自產品價格調整，而非出貨顆數增加。

出貨量維持平盤，營收為何大幅成長？
晶豪科(3006-TW)以利基型記憶體為主，DRAM約占營收55%，其中DDR2及DDR3合計接近四成，是目前最重要的產品。隨主要記憶體廠將產能轉向DDR4、DDR5及HBM，DDR3以下的成熟產品供給逐步減少，部分原有客戶訂單也轉向晶豪科。
然而，晶豪科(3006-TW)本身同樣受到晶圓代工產能限制。公司先前表示，市場需求已超過可供應數量，2026年能取得的產能難以明顯增加，因此營收成長主要來自記憶體報價上漲。
此外，公司不少產品採取合約價，價格反映通常落後市場約一季，從投片到產品完成也需要4至5個月。換句話說，先前現貨價格與合約價格上漲的效益，可能持續遞延反映在後續營收。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

9月營收月減，缺貨行情反轉了嗎？
晶豪科(3006-TW)9月營收較8月減少5.61%，但單月仍維持74億元以上，且第三季營收較前一季大增近六成，目前尚不足以判定記憶體行情反轉。
真正需要觀察的是，第四季合約價能否延續漲勢，公司曾指出，利基型記憶體供給缺口在2026年內仍難以舒緩，DDR2、DDR3及Flash價格仍處於調升過程；若主要供應商持續退出成熟產品，公司仍有機會受惠轉單及價格上漲。
不過，晶圓代工、封裝測試及基板等成本也同步提高。由於公司出貨量成長有限，後續獲利能否繼續擴大，取決於產品漲價幅度能否超過代工成本增加，而不能只看營收創高。
因此，晶豪科(3006-TW)這波成長的核心不是賣出更多記憶體，而是相同產能可以創造更高營收。第四季除了觀察單月營收能否維持高檔，更重要的是毛利率能否隨合約價上漲持續改善；若售價漲幅無法覆蓋成本，營收快速增加也未必能等比例轉化為獲利。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

paras_en: On October 5, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Jinghao Technology (3006‑TW) announced September revenue of NT$7.461 billion, which is 5.61% lower than the August historical peak but still up 470.23% from the same month last year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$43.363 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 343.91%.

Further calculations show that Jinghao Technology’s Q3 revenue was about NT$22.150 billion, up 58.8% from the Q2 figure of NT$13.946 billion, indicating that memory shortages and price hikes continued to lift the company’s sales scale.

However, the most noteworthy aspect of this growth is that Jinghao Technology’s shipment volume did not rise in tandem. In its March earnings briefing, the company said that its 2026 production capacity is expected to remain roughly flat, and most of the revenue growth will come from product price adjustments rather than an increase in shipped units.

Why does revenue grow sharply while shipments stay flat? Jinghao Technology focuses on niche‑type memory, with DRAM accounting for about 55% of revenue; DDR2 and DDR3 together make up nearly 40% and are currently its most important products. As major memory makers shift capacity toward DDR4, DDR5 and HBM, supply of mature products below DDR3 is gradually shrinking, and some existing customers are moving orders to Jinghao.

Nevertheless, Jinghao itself is also constrained by wafer‑foundry capacity. The company previously noted that market demand has already exceeded the available supply, and the capacity it can secure in 2026 is unlikely to increase significantly, so revenue growth is mainly driven by higher memory pricing.

In addition, many of the company’s products are sold under contract pricing, which typically lags the market by about a quarter. From wafer start to finished product takes four to five months, meaning the benefit of earlier spot‑price and contract‑price increases may continue to be reflected in later revenue periods.
[Image source: U‑Analysis industry database]

September revenue fell month‑over‑month, but has the shortage rally reversed? Jinghao’s September revenue dropped 5.61% from August, yet it still stayed above NT$7.4 billion for the month, and Q3 revenue surged nearly 60% from the prior quarter, which is not yet enough to conclude that the memory market has turned around.

What truly needs watching is whether Q4 contract prices can sustain the upward trend. The company has pointed out that the supply gap for niche memory will remain difficult to alleviate throughout 2026, and prices for DDR2, DDR3 and Flash are still in an upward adjustment phase; if major suppliers continue to exit mature products, Jinghao could benefit from order shifts and price gains.

However, costs for wafer foundry, packaging, testing and substrates are also rising in tandem. Because shipment growth is limited, future profit expansion will depend on whether price increases can outpace the rise in foundry costs, not merely on higher revenue figures.

Thus, the core of Jinghao’s growth wave is not selling more memory but generating higher revenue from the same capacity. In Q4, besides watching whether monthly revenue can stay at a high level, the more important metric is whether gross margin improves alongside rising contract prices; if price hikes cannot cover cost increases, rapid revenue growth may not translate proportionally into profit.
