items.title_en: Breaking the 70K Barrier! Nikkei 225 Soars Over 1,700 Points; US Futures, Gold, Silver, and Bitcoin All Rally
paras: 亞洲股市周一(5日)早盤風險情緒回暖，日股、貴金屬、加密貨幣同步走升，日經225指數大漲1728點、漲幅2.53%，美股三大期貨指數亦小幅走高，現貨黃金站上4158美元、白銀漲破61美元，比特幣攀漲近1.8%，主要因為市場認為美國9月就業遠遜預期，讓Fed本月中再度升息預期降溫，資金回流風險資產。
日股周一由半導體與AI供應鏈領攻，瑞薩電子漲逾7%，東京電子漲逾5%，愛德萬測試漲逾4%，東京精密、科意半導體、羅姆、軟銀等漲超3%，因美光最新財報優於預期，提振全球記憶體與AI伺服器鏈，加上外資加速回補亞太股市及日本資料中心與電力建設題材發酵。
外媒最新報導指出，日本擬以民間投資推動約1400億美元計畫，加速AI資料中心落地，進一步強化半導體與電力設備需求預期。
日本電力巨頭JERA、戴爾及英國AI基礎設施企業Rhaelm近日達成協議，將在東京附近投資150億美元，建造一座400兆瓦的資料中心。
JERA全球總裁金井幸雄表示，三家企業打算在五年內建成總規模3-4GW的AI資料中心配套燃氣發電基礎設施。「核心關鍵字是快速供電能力。」
JERA每年可交易3500萬噸液化天然氣，可為電站提供燃料。根據金井幸雄估算，1GW算力配套基建的造價在350億至450億美元之間。按此推算，建成上述規模基礎設施的總投入約需1400億美元。
日本本土擁有NTT資料、軟銀等大型資料中心營運商，黑石集團也打算未來數年在日本投入300億美元佈局相關業務。
paras_en: Asian markets on Monday (the 5th) saw risk sentiment improve in early trading, with Japanese equities, precious metals and cryptocurrencies all climbing. The Nikkei 225 jumped 1,728 points, up 2.53%, while the three major US futures indices edged higher. Spot gold rose above $4,158, silver broke $61, and Bitcoin gained nearly 1.8%, mainly because the market believes September US employment data will fall short of expectations, cooling expectations of another Fed rate hike this month and prompting a flow of capital back into risk assets.

Japanese stocks on Monday were led by the semiconductor and AI supply chain, with Renesas Electronics up more than 7%, Tokyo Electron up over 5%, Advantest up more than 4%, and Tokyo Seimitsu, Kioxia, Rohm, SoftBank and others gaining over 3%. The rally was fueled by Micron’s better‑than‑expected earnings, which lifted global memory and AI server chains, alongside accelerating foreign‑fund repurchases in Asia‑Pacific equities and growing interest in Japanese data‑center and power‑construction themes.

Foreign media reports say Japan plans to use private investment to drive a roughly $140 billion program that will accelerate the rollout of AI data centers, further strengthening expectations for semiconductor and power‑equipment demand.
Japanese power giant JERA, Dell and UK AI‑infrastructure firm Rhaelm recently reached an agreement to invest $15 billion near Tokyo to build a 400‑megawatt data center.

JERA Global President Yukio Kanai said the three companies aim to develop AI data‑center supporting gas‑power infrastructure with a total capacity of 3‑4 GW within five years. “The core keyword is rapid power‑supply capability,” he said.

JERA can trade 35 million tonnes of liquefied natural gas each year, providing fuel for power plants. Kanai estimates that the infrastructure to support 1 GW of compute power will cost between $35 billion and $45 billion. By that calculation, the total investment needed to build the aforementioned infrastructure would be about $140 billion.

Japan’s domestic operators such as NTT Data and SoftBank run large data‑center businesses, and Blackstone also plans to commit $30 billion over the coming years in Japan to develop related operations.

items.title: 輝達黃仁勳押注「美國DeepSeek」！AI新創Reflection擬推首款開放權重模型
paras: 獲得輝達(NVDA-US) 8 億美元投資的人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Reflection，正準備推出首款開放權重模型，瞄準目前由中國業者主導的開放 AI 模型市場，試圖為西方 AI 產業開闢新的競爭戰場。
根據《Axios》報導，Reflection 首款模型初期的能力預料仍不及美國頂尖尖端 AI 模型，但有望直接挑戰中國領先的開放權重模型。
知情人士指出，Reflection 的模型已具備相當程度的智慧能力，足以協助企業以較低成本打造專屬 AI 系統。
即使開放模型的能力略遜於頂尖閉源模型，只要結合企業自身的高品質資料，最終成果在某些情況下仍可能媲美成本最高的尖端 AI 系統。

開放權重模型崛起 中國領先、西方急起直追

開放權重模型與 ChatGPT、Claude 等閉源 AI 模型的主要差異，在於開發者可依照授權條款下載及修改模型本身，讓個人開發者與中小企業能更靈活地運用 AI 技術。
然而，目前全球最強大的開放權重模型幾乎都來自中國。在提供大量 AI 模型的平台上，開放模型的合計使用量有時甚至已占多數。
不過，在支出規模更大的企業 AI 市場，開放權重模型的滲透率仍相對有限。
多名 AI 公司高層與分析師指出，企業目前通常透過 API 及企業帳戶付費使用 AI 服務，開放權重模型在這類市場的普及程度仍不高。
Reflection 加入戰局，加上其他西方業者預計本月陸續推出開放權重模型，可能改變目前的市場競爭格局。知情人士透露，Reflection 發布模型後，還將有其他西方廠商跟進。
Reflection 執行長Misha Laskin曾任職於 Google。他先前接受《CNBC》訪問時坦言，公司要讓 AI 模型達到業界最先進水準仍需時間，並以火箭研發比喻模型開發的難度：「它們有點像火箭。要打造一枚大型火箭，需要時間。」
在模型正式推出前，Reflection 已開始與華盛頓及其他地區的相關人士接觸，介紹即將發布的模型，以及公司所倡議的「AI 工廠」概念。
不過，Reflection 尚未公布模型的確切發布日期及具體效能數據。
隨著 Reflection 等業者投入開放權重模型市場，AI 產業的競爭焦點也逐漸擴大。過去市場主要關注 OpenAI、Anthropic 與Google(GOOGL-US) 之間的頂尖閉源模型競爭，如今，誰能打造出最強大的開放權重模型，正成為另一項重要的產業競爭指標。

Reflection 力推「AI 工廠」 讓企業打造專屬 AI 系統

不過，Reflection 的目標不僅是推出開放權重模型，更希望打造「AI 工廠」，讓企業及政府機構結合自有資料、Reflection 模型與運算資源，建立高度客製化、成本更低的在地 AI 系統。
避險基金、交易公司等持有高度機密資料的機構，已對這種模式展現濃厚興趣。Reflection 也已開始推動相關計畫，今年 3 月與南韓新世界集團（Shinsegae Group）簽署合作備忘錄，計畫在韓國興建一座 250 MW 的 AI 工廠，採用 Reflection 模型及輝達晶片運作。
事實上，AI 工廠並非 Reflection 首創的概念，而是輝達執行長黃仁勳長期倡議的 AI 發展方向。
黃仁勳多次描繪未來企業運用 AI 的模式，透過結合 AI 運算硬體與開放模型，在保有資料所有權及控制權的前提下，打造企業專屬的 AI 系統。
根據《華爾街日報》與《The Information》先前報導，黃仁勳長期支持開放 AI 生態系，並大力支持 Reflection 朝打造頂尖開放 AI 系統的方向轉型。

輝達投資 8 億美元 Reflection 大舉鎖定算力資源

輝達在 Reflection 的發展布局中扮演重要角色，不僅投資 8 億美元，也是該公司最重要的財務支持者之一。
為支撐模型訓練及未來業務擴張，Reflection 近期也積極取得大型運算資源，與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及雲端運算公司 Nebius(NBIS-US) 簽訂大額合作協議。
今年 6 月，Reflection 與 SpaceX簽署協議，取得使用 SpaceX Colossus 2 資料中心內輝達 GB300 晶片的權利。
根據合約，自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起至 2029 年，在初期資源擴充階段結束後，Reflection 每月將向 SpaceX 支付 1.5 億美元。
協議也規定，雙方在合約生效前三個月後，均可提前 90 天通知終止合作。
此外，Reflection 今年 7 月也與雲端運算公司 Nebius達成協議，後者同意提供逾 10 億美元的運算資源，合約期限至 2029 年。該消息公布當天，Nebius 股價隨即下跌。
透過與 SpaceX 的合作，Reflection 不僅取得輝達高階晶片的運算資源，也進一步深化與輝達的合作關係。

items.title: 憂過度依賴AI！華爾街積極「去集中化」：獲利修正等風險恐改變市場方向
items.title_en: Worried About Over‑Reliance on AI! Wall Street Actively “De‑centralizes”: Profit Corrections and Other Risks Could Shift Market Direction
paras: 隨著AI日益成為驅動美國金融市場和宏觀經濟的引擎，投資者在享受科技紅利的同時，正警惕因過度依賴AI而產生的潛在風險。
英國《金融時報》報導，面對AI相關資產在股市和債市的高度集中，基金經理人正積極尋找策略，以對沖技術情緒突變可能帶來的衝擊。
根據花旗集團最新研究，羅素1000指數中，超過三分之二的大型美國公司已直接與AI相關，或是商業模式深度融入該技術。
摩根大通的數據進一步揭示這一趨勢的廣泛性。在AI支出熱潮中，大型科技「超大規模企業」及其受益者大量發債，目前已佔據美國高等級債券市場的16%，成為投資級市場中的最大群體。
歐洲最大資產管理公司鋒裕匯理(Amundi)投資長Vincent Mortier指出，儘管AI主題「非常強大」，但客戶正在重新審視多元化配置的方式，但示警稱「獲利大幅修正」等意外事件恐改變市場方向。
貝萊德全球多元資產策略主管Ryan Marshall也表示，建構引入獨立、非相關回報來源的投資組合「絕對是當前需求所在」。他認為，除直接的AI曝險，其供應商如電力、基礎設施等「第二層同心圓」也與總體經濟成長高度綁定，這促使資金流向私募資產、避險基金等低相關性領域。
在具體策略上，富蘭克林鄧普頓聯合總裁Daniel Gamba透露，投資團隊正將AI視為一種「因子」，透過系統性對沖基金來構建對AI波動性敞口最小的投資組合。
Gamba也強調，雖然仍看好美國股票，但樂觀程度已不及年初，資金正明顯尋求多元化，轉向日本、新興市場以及短期固定收益產品。
Mortier則引用花旗前老闆Chuck Prince在2007年金融危機前的名言作為警示：「音樂還在播放，人們還在跳舞。」他也坦言，雖不知音樂停止的時機，但這正是多元化配置比以往任何時候都更為必要的原因。
paras_en: As AI increasingly becomes the engine driving the U.S. financial markets and macro‑economy, investors are enjoying the tech dividend while warning of potential risks from over‑reliance on AI.

The Financial Times reported that, faced with the high concentration of AI‑related assets in equities and bonds, fund managers are actively seeking strategies to hedge against the impact of sudden shifts in tech sentiment.

According to Citi’s latest research, more than two‑thirds of the large U.S. companies in the Russell 1000 index are either directly tied to AI or have business models deeply integrated with the technology.

JPMorgan data further reveal the breadth of this trend. In the AI‑spending boom, large‑cap “mega‑scale enterprises” and their beneficiaries have issued massive amounts of debt, now accounting for 16% of the U.S. high‑grade bond market, making them the largest group in the investment‑grade space.

Vincent Mortier, Head of Investments at Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi, said that although the AI theme is “very strong,” clients are re‑examining diversification approaches and warned that unexpected events such as “large profit revisions” could change market direction.

Ryan Marshall, Global Multi‑Asset Strategy Head at BlackRock, also noted that building portfolios that incorporate independent, non‑correlated sources of return “is absolutely the current demand.” He added that beyond direct AI exposure, its suppliers—such as power and infrastructure firms in the “second‑layer concentric circle”—are tightly linked to overall economic growth, prompting capital to flow into private‑equity, hedge‑fund and other low‑correlation assets.

In terms of concrete tactics, Daniel Gamba, Co‑President of Franklin Templeton, said his investment team treats AI as a “factor” and constructs portfolios with minimal AI‑volatility exposure by using systematic hedge‑fund strategies.

Gamba also stressed that while he remains bullish on U.S. equities, his optimism is lower than at the start of the year, with capital clearly seeking diversification by shifting toward Japan, emerging markets and short‑term fixed‑income products.

Mortier quoted former Citi CEO Chuck Prince’s pre‑2007‑crisis warning: “The music is still playing, and people are still dancing.” He admitted he doesn’t know when the music will stop, but that uncertainty makes diversification more necessary than ever.

items.title: 馬斯克擬將SpaceXAI更名為SpaceXSI！響應川普倡議 改用「超級智慧」取代人工智慧
items.title_en: Musk Plans to Rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI, Echoing Trump’s Call to Use “Super Intelligence” Instead of Artificial Intelligence
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克週日（4 日）在社群平台 X 發文表示，計畫將旗下人工智慧（AI）部門 SpaceXAI 更名為 SpaceXSI。
根據《路透》報導，馬斯克此舉呼應美國總統川普近期倡議，主張以「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence）取代「人工智慧」（Artificial Intelligence）一詞。
有網友在 X 詢問馬斯克，是否可能將 SpaceXAI 更名為 SpaceXSI。馬斯克對此簡短回覆：「是的，我們會做出這項改變。」
不過，截至報導發布時，SpaceXAI 的 X 官方帳號名稱尚未變更。
SpaceXAI 目前尚未立即回應媒體針對更名計畫提出的置評請求。
川普上個月在聯合國大會發表演說時表示：「從現在起，美國所有文件，以及我希望全世界的文件，都將改用更為精確的『超級』一詞，而非『人工』。因此，應稱為『超級智慧』。」
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk posted on the social platform X on Sunday (the 4th) that he plans to rename the company’s artificial intelligence division, SpaceXAI, to SpaceXSI.
According to Reuters, Musk’s move aligns with a recent initiative by U.S. President Donald Trump, who advocates replacing the term “Artificial Intelligence” with “Super Intelligence.”
A user on X asked Musk whether SpaceXAI could be renamed to SpaceXSI. Musk replied briefly, “Yes, we will make that change.”
However, as of the time the report was published, the official X account name for SpaceXAI had not yet been changed.
SpaceXAI has not yet responded to media requests for comment on the renaming plan.

Last month, Trump said at the United Nations General Assembly, “From now on, all U.S. documents—and I hope all documents worldwide—should use the more precise term ‘super’ instead of ‘artificial.’ Therefore, it should be called ‘Super Intelligence.’”

items.title: 白宮AI峰會變權力觀察現場！專家解析祖克柏、馬斯克與川普互動：誰最自在？
items.title_en: White House AI Summit Becomes a Power‑Dynamics Showcase: Experts Analyze Zuckerberg, Musk and Trump Interactions – Who Looks Most Comfortable?
paras: 美國白宮上週二舉行人工智慧（AI）峰會，會議結束後，科技巨頭與美國總統川普在媒體面前的互動意外成為焦點，網路上掀起一波對與會者肢體語言、彼此關係及權力動態的熱烈討論。

包括Meta(META-US) 執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）、特斯拉(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）、Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）、輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳、Google(GOOGL-US) 執行長皮查伊（Sundar Pichai）及OpenAI總裁布羅克曼（Greg Brockman）等皆齊聚一堂，討論AI安全與資料中心建設。
峰會最終促成各方簽署一份自願性承諾協議，川普將其形容為具有「道德約束力」的協議。
根據《The Information》報導，行為科學家、肢體語言專家Abbie Maroño分析指出，這場峰會不僅呈現AI產業與華府之間的政策互動，也讓科技領袖與政治權力核心之間微妙的關係浮上檯面。
與會者彼此之間存在競爭、對立、合作與結盟等多重關係，而這些關係也可能影響未來AI政策的發展。

祖克柏與川普互動自然，展現從容姿態

Maroño認為，祖克柏是此次峰會中最能展現權力感的與會者。
她觀察到，祖克柏大部分時間站在川普身旁，舉止自然且從容，沒有刻意展現自己的姿態。她表示，祖克柏身處權力核心旁，卻顯得相當自在，反映出他在這個場合中展現的影響力。
Maroño特別注意到，當祖克柏朝川普走近時，川普隨即後退並轉身面向他。她認為，這個細節呈現出兩人之間無須言語的默契，也顯示祖克柏具有一定的權力，而川普相當尊重有影響力的人物。
此外，祖克柏在發言時語氣沉穩，眼神自然，既不刻意低頭，也沒有四處游移，表達方式不顯誇張。
Maroño指出，川普在祖克柏發言時頻頻點頭，兩人似乎處於相同的溝通節奏。

阿莫戴發言積極，肢體動作透露緊張

相較於祖克柏的從容，Anthropic執行長阿莫戴雖然在峰會上獲得最多發言時間，卻呈現出不同的肢體訊號。
Maroño指出，阿莫戴頻繁使用手勢，動作幅度大，表面上展現出通常與自信相關的行為，但整體舉止卻流露出不自在與焦慮，彷彿一邊努力表現自信，一邊又難以掩飾內心的不安。
她認為，過度誇張的手勢不一定代表真正的自信。真正的自信應該表現得流暢自然，但阿莫戴的動作節奏偏快，給人一種不斷提醒自己要使用手勢的感覺。當他短暫停頓時，則會將雙手緊握在一起，這被視為一種典型的自我安撫動作。
峰會期間，川普介紹阿莫戴時曾表示：「他說的都沒問題。」Maroño對此提出另一種解讀，認為這句話不只是對阿莫戴發言的肯定，也可能是在傳遞權力訊號。
她指出，川普此舉可能是在提醒阿莫戴，他能夠在白宮發言，是因為川普允許他這麼做，並藉此傳達「只要與我站在同一陣線，就不會有問題，但不要越界」的訊息。

馬斯克站在人群邊緣，與川普互動顯得疏離

與祖克柏積極融入峰會氛圍形成對比，馬斯克則展現出相對疏離的姿態。
Maroño觀察到，馬斯克大部分時間雙臂交叉，站在人群邊緣，肢體動作明顯少於其他與會者，發言次數也相對有限。
她認為，馬斯克交叉雙臂的動作在這個場合不一定代表防禦或抗拒，反而更可能反映出社交上的疏離感，以及一種置身事外的旁觀者心態。
更引人注意的是，當川普發言時，馬斯克並未像其他與會者一樣將身體轉向川普。
Maroño表示，當權威人物發言時，人們通常會轉向對方，以示尊重。她不認為馬斯克是在刻意表現不敬，但其展現的尊重程度確實低於其他與會者。
在她看來，這個細節反映出馬斯克與川普之間關係的起伏與複雜性。

AI自願承諾協議成焦點，產業自律能否發揮作用受關注

除了科技領袖之間的互動，此次白宮峰會的另一項重要成果，是各大AI企業共同簽署一份涵蓋AI安全與資料中心建設等議題的自願性承諾協議。
川普將這份協議形容為具有「道德約束力」，但其實際約束效果仍存在疑問。
《The Information》將這份協議比喻為「讓操場上的孩子們自我管理」，點出在缺乏外部強制執行機制的情況下，企業能否單靠自律落實承諾，仍有待觀察。
這場峰會也罕見地將AI產業與華府之間的權力互動公開呈現在大眾面前。科技巨頭與政治人物之間錯綜複雜的競爭、合作與利益關係，不僅反映出當前AI產業的權力結構，也讓未來AI監管政策的走向增添更多變數。
paras_en: The White House held an artificial intelligence (AI) summit last Tuesday, and after the meeting ended, the on‑stage interaction between tech giants and President Trump unexpectedly became the focus, sparking a wave of online discussion about the participants' body language, their relationships, and the power dynamics at play.

Attendees included Meta (META‑US) CEO Mark Zuckerberg, Tesla (TSLA‑US) CEO Elon Musk, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang, Google (GOOGL‑US) CEO Sundar Pichai, and OpenAI president Greg Brockman, who gathered to discuss AI safety and data‑center construction.
The summit ultimately produced a voluntary commitment agreement signed by the parties, which Trump described as a "morally binding" pact.

According to a report by The Information, behavioral scientist and body‑language expert Abbie Maroño noted that the summit not only showcased policy interaction between the AI industry and Washington but also brought the subtle relationship between tech leaders and the core of political power into view.
Participants displayed a mix of competition, opposition, cooperation and alliance, relationships that could shape the future development of AI policy.
Zuckerberg’s interaction with Trump was natural, showing a relaxed demeanor. Maroño believes Zuckerberg was the participant who most clearly projected a sense of power at the summit.

She observed that Zuckerberg spent most of his time standing beside Trump, behaving naturally and calmly without trying to flaunt his posture. She said that being next to the center of power yet appearing completely at ease reflected the influence he wielded in that setting.

Maroño especially noted that when Zuckerberg approached Trump, the president stepped back and turned to face him. She interpreted this detail as a wordless rapport between the two, indicating that Zuckerberg possessed a certain degree of power and that Trump showed considerable respect for influential figures.
In addition, Zuckerberg’s speaking tone was steady and his gaze natural; he neither deliberately lowered his head nor wandered his eyes, delivering his remarks without exaggeration.
Maroño pointed out that Trump nodded frequently while Zuckerberg spoke, suggesting the two were on the same communication rhythm.

Amodei spoke assertively, but his body language revealed tension. Compared with Zuckerberg’s composure, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who received the most speaking time at the summit, displayed different physical cues.

Maroño noted that Amodei used hand gestures frequently and with large amplitude, outwardly showing behavior usually linked to confidence, yet his overall demeanor leaked discomfort and anxiety, as if he was trying hard to appear confident while unable to hide inner unease.

She argued that overly exaggerated gestures do not necessarily signal genuine confidence. True confidence should appear fluid and natural, whereas Amodei’s rapid gesturing gave the impression of constantly reminding himself to use his hands. When he paused briefly, he clenched his hands together, a classic self‑soothing motion.

During the summit, when Trump introduced Amodei, he said, "Everything he says is fine." Maroño offered another reading, suggesting the remark was not only an endorsement of Amodei’s remarks but also a subtle power signal.

She explained that Trump’s comment could be reminding Amodei that his ability to speak at the White House was granted by Trump, conveying the message, "As long as you stand on my side, there’s no problem, but don’t overstep."

Musk stood on the fringe of the crowd, and his interaction with Trump appeared detached. In contrast to Zuckerberg’s active integration into the summit atmosphere, Musk displayed a relatively aloof posture.
Maroño observed that Musk spent most of his time with his arms crossed, standing at the edge of the group, moving far less than other participants and speaking only sparingly.

She believes that crossing his arms in this context does not necessarily indicate defensiveness or resistance; rather, it likely reflects social distance and a spectator‑like mindset, as if he were observing from the outside.
What stood out even more was that when Trump spoke, Musk did not turn his body toward the president as other attendees did.

Maroño said that people usually turn toward an authority figure when they speak, as a sign of respect. She does not think Musk was deliberately being disrespectful, but his level of deference was clearly lower than that of the other participants.
In her view, this detail mirrors the ups and downs and complexity of the relationship between Musk and Trump.

The AI voluntary commitment agreement became a focal point, raising questions about whether industry self‑regulation can be effective. Beyond the interactions among tech leaders, another major outcome of the White House summit was a jointly signed voluntary pledge covering AI safety and data‑center construction.
Trump described the pledge as having "moral binding force," but its actual enforceability remains doubtful.

The Information likened the agreement to "children managing themselves on a playground," pointing out that without external enforcement mechanisms, it remains to be seen whether companies can rely solely on self‑discipline to fulfill their promises.

The summit also unusually put the power interaction between the AI industry and Washington on public display. The tangled web of competition, cooperation and vested interests between tech giants and political figures not only reflects the current power structure of the AI sector but also adds further variables to the future direction of AI regulatory policy.

items.title: 美國正重演1970年代滯脹危機？薪資追不上通膨、專家點「避險策略」
items.title_en: Is the U.S. Repeating the 1970s Stagflation Crisis? Wages Lag Behind Inflation, Experts Suggest Hedging Strategies
paras: 美國經濟正浮現1970年代的部分警訊，包括通膨升溫、實質薪資下滑、能源危機與國際衝突加劇。隨著最新就業報告顯示，美國薪資增幅遠低於物價漲幅，就業成長也大幅放緩，市場開始關注，這個全球最大經濟體是否正走向另一個經濟停滯與通膨並存的艱困時期。
《MarketWatch》專欄指出，當前美國經濟與1970年代存在多項相似之處。當年美股與債券等主流資產表現疲弱，投資人若只依賴傳統投資組合，可能難以抵禦通膨侵蝕。
若類似情境再度出現，投資策略或許需要轉向防禦，並重新評估黃金、能源股及抗通膨債券在退休投資組合中的角色。
美國勞工部週五（2日）公布的最新數據顯示，美國上月平均時薪僅月增0.13%，相當於每小時增加約0.05美元，且尚未扣除稅負。
相較之下，克里夫蘭聯準銀行最新估計，9月消費者物價月增0.53%，約為薪資增幅的4倍。
薪資與物價的落差也反映在長期購買力上。過去一年，美國平均時薪年增3%，但物價上漲3.6%，通膨幾乎抵銷勞工近兩年累積的薪資增幅，使實質時薪回落至2024年秋季水準。
除了薪資購買力遭侵蝕，就業市場也出現降溫跡象。最新報告顯示，美國上月新增就業人數遠低於經濟學家預期，不到預測值的三分之一。
進一步檢視過去一年的人口與就業變化，出生於美國的就業人口減少近100萬人，同期移民就業人數則增加約50萬人，與美國政府打擊移民的政策方向形成對照。

荷姆茲海峽危機推升能源成本 通膨壓力恐持續擴大

能源危機是目前美國通膨壓力的重要來源。文章將伊朗控制荷姆茲海峽的局勢，與1970年代兩次石油輸出國組織（OPEC）石油禁運相提並論，指出能源供應受阻可能帶來廣泛的經濟衝擊。
柴油價格飆升不僅增加運輸成本，也可能推升各類商品與服務價格。克里夫蘭聯準銀行估計，美國上月物價年化漲幅達6.5%，若這項估計成真，通膨升溫的程度將進一步加劇。美國官方9月通膨數據預計於10月14日公布。
專欄指出，短期內薪資與物價增幅的差距或許看似有限，但若這種趨勢持續，累積效應將逐步侵蝕民眾生活水準。1970年代美國實質平均薪資累計下滑7%。
此外，官方通膨數據能否完整反映一般家庭的實際生活成本，也受到質疑。隨著日常採購與每月帳單持續增加，民眾感受到的通膨壓力可能與統計數字存在落差。
文章也指出，美國經濟不滿情緒已跨越政黨界線，甚至包括多數共和黨選民在內，對經濟現況感到不滿。

1970年代傳統資產表現疲弱 黃金與能源股相對抗跌

文章指出，若美國經濟再次陷入長期通膨與低成長環境，1970年代的資產表現或許能為投資人提供參考。
根據紐約大學史登商學院（NYU Stern School of Business）數據，1970年初至1980年初，標普500指數扣除通膨後，整整10年累計實質報酬僅約4%，並非年化報酬，而是整個十年的總報酬，且尚未扣除稅費。
同期，美國短期國庫券及現金投資的實質價值下滑11%，投資級公司債實質報酬為負17%，10年期美國公債則損失35%。
相較之下，能源股與黃金展現不同的表現。根據達特茅斯學院金融學教授Kenneth French的數據，1970年代能源股扣除通膨後仍讓投資人資產翻倍，黃金實質價格則上漲逾500%。
黃金當時的大幅上漲，部分原因在於此前約40年間，黃金價格受到政府政策壓抑。

抗通膨債券實質殖利率吸引投資人 留意長天期波動風險

除了黃金與能源股，抗通膨公債（TIPS）也是文章提出的另一項配置選擇。
TIPS的本金會依據消費者物價指數（CPI）變動調整，藉此降低通膨對債券購買力的侵蝕。不過，這類債券在1970年代尚未問世。
文章指出，今年TIPS價格走低，使投資人有機會鎖定高於通膨的實質殖利率。即使是存續期間較短、風險與波動相對較低的債券，實質殖利率也可達2.5%；長天期TIPS的實質殖利率則最高約3.3%。
不過，要注意的是，長天期債券伴隨較大的價格波動。
對於希望降低波動風險的投資人，專欄提及安碩美國0-5年期抗通脹國債指數ETF(STIP-US) ，作為短天期抗通膨債券基金的例子。這類基金兼具通膨防護與相對較低的價格波動。
文章最後強調，重返1970年代的經濟困境並非必然，但在能源危機、通膨壓力與薪資成長停滯等風險交織之際，投資人仍應為較不利的經濟情境預作準備。
該文章引用小說角色傑克．李奇（Jack Reacher）的話，核心精神是「抱持最好的希望，同時為最壞的情況做好準備」。
paras_en: The U.S. economy is showing some warning signs reminiscent of the 1970s, including rising inflation, declining real wages, an energy crisis, and escalating international conflicts. With the latest employment report showing wage growth far below price increases and job growth slowing sharply, markets are beginning to question whether the world's largest economy is heading toward another period of economic stagnation and persistent inflation.

A MarketWatch column notes that the current U.S. economy shares several similarities with the 1970s. At that time, U.S. equities and bonds and other mainstream assets performed poorly, and investors relying solely on traditional portfolios may struggle to withstand inflationary erosion.
If a similar scenario reoccurs, investment strategies may need to shift toward defense and re-evaluate the role of gold, energy stocks, and inflation‑protected bonds in retirement portfolios.
The U.S. Department of Labor released on Friday (Feb. 2) that the average hourly wage last month rose only 0.13% month‑over‑month, about $0.05 per hour, before taxes.
In contrast, the Cleveland Fed’s latest estimate shows September’s consumer price index rising 0.53% month‑over‑month, roughly four times the wage increase.

The gap between wages and prices also reflects long‑term purchasing power. Over the past year, the average hourly wage grew 3% annually, while prices rose 3.6%, so inflation nearly offset workers’ cumulative wage gains over the past two years, bringing real hourly wages back to fall‑2024 levels.

Beyond wage erosion, the labor market shows signs of cooling. The latest report indicates that last month’s job gains were far below economists’ expectations, less than one‑third of forecasted numbers.

A deeper look at the past year’s population and employment changes shows that the U.S. native‑born workforce shrank by nearly one million, while immigrant employment rose by about 500,000, contrasting with the government’s anti‑immigration policy direction.

The Homs Strait crisis has pushed up energy costs, and inflationary pressure may continue to expand. The energy crisis remains a key source of U.S. inflation, with the article comparing Iran’s control of the Homs Strait to the two OPEC oil embargoes of the 1970s, noting that supply disruptions could have widespread economic impacts.

Diesel prices spiking not only raise transportation costs but may also lift prices of various goods and services. The Cleveland Fed estimates that last month’s annualized price increase reached 6.5%; if this estimate proves true, the degree of inflationary acceleration will worsen. Official September inflation data are expected on Oct. 14.

The column points out that, in the short term, the gap between wage and price growth may seem limited, but if this trend continues, the cumulative effect will gradually erode living standards. In the 1970s, U.S. real average wages fell cumulatively by 7%.

Moreover, there is doubt whether official inflation data fully reflect the actual cost of living for ordinary households. As daily purchases and monthly bills rise, the inflation pressure felt by people may differ from statistical figures.
The article also notes that U.S. economic dissatisfaction has crossed party lines, even including most Republican voters, who feel discontent with the current economic situation.

In the 1970s, traditional assets performed poorly, while gold and energy stocks offered relative protection. The article suggests that if the U.S. economy falls into a long‑term inflation and low‑growth environment again, the 1970s asset performance may provide guidance for investors.

According to data from NYU Stern School of Business, from early 1970 to early 1980, the S&P 500’s real return over the entire decade was only about 4%, not an annualized return but the total return for the decade, and before taxes.

During the same period, the real value of U.S. short‑term Treasury bills and cash fell 11%, investment‑grade corporate bonds yielded a negative 17% real return, and 10‑year U.S. Treasuries lost 35% in real terms.

In contrast, energy stocks and gold showed different performance. According to data from Kenneth French of Dartmouth College, energy stocks in the 1970s, after inflation adjustment, still doubled investors’ assets, while gold’s real price rose over 500%.
Gold’s sharp rise at the time was partly due to government policy suppression of gold prices over the previous 40 years.
Inflation‑protected bonds (TIPS) also represent another allocation choice highlighted in the article, alongside gold and energy stocks.
TIPS principal is adjusted according to the Consumer Price Index (CPI) to reduce the erosion of purchasing power. However, such bonds did not exist in the 1970s.

The article notes that this year TIPS prices have fallen, giving investors an opportunity to lock in real yields above inflation. Even short‑term bonds with relatively lower risk and volatility can yield a real return of 2.5%, while long‑term TIPS can reach about 3.3% real yield.
However, it is important to note that long‑term bonds come with greater price volatility.

For investors seeking to reduce volatility risk, the column mentions the iShares U.S. 0‑5 Year TIPS Index ETF (STIP‑US) as an example of a short‑term inflation‑protected bond fund. Such funds offer inflation protection with relatively low price volatility.

The article concludes by emphasizing that returning to the economic difficulties of the 1970s is not inevitable, but amid intertwined risks of energy crises, inflationary pressure, and stagnant wage growth, investors should still prepare for less favorable economic scenarios.
The article quotes the fictional character Jack Reacher, whose core philosophy is to “hold onto the best hope while preparing for the worst.”

items.title: 標普500未來一年面臨壓力？美銀賣方指標逼近美股「賣出」訊號、升至2022年高點
items.title_en: Is the S&P 500 Facing Pressure Over the Next Year? Bank of America Sell‑Side Indicator Nears a “Sell” Signal, Rising to 2022 High
paras: 美股主要指數持續徘徊在歷史高點附近，但市場內部已浮現疲態。美國銀行最新數據顯示，備受市場關注的「賣方指標」（Sell Side Indicator，SSI）持續攀升，距離正式觸發賣出訊號僅一步之遙。歷史數據顯示，當該指標進入賣出區間，標普500指數未來12個月的平均報酬率通常低於長期平均水準。
根據《Business Insider》報導，美銀本周發布客戶報告指出，SSI在9月從56.4%升至57.2%，距離正式的賣出區間僅差0.3個百分點。這也是該指標自2022年3月以來的最高水準。
SSI是一項反向市場指標，當市場極度悲觀時，可能代表買進時機將至；反之，當市場情緒極度樂觀時，則釋出賣出訊號。
根據美銀統計，當SSI過去觸發賣出訊號時，標普500指數未來12個月平均仍上漲約3%，但明顯落後於約10%的歷史平均報酬率。
該行指出，根據追溯至1985年的股市數據分析，當SSI處於目前水準或更高時，標普500指數未來12個月有36%的機率出現負報酬。
美銀股票與量化研究團隊指出，SSI長期以來一直是可靠的反向指標。儘管無法準確捕捉股市每一次漲跌，但與其他市場擇時工具相比，該指標歷來在標普500指數未來12個月總報酬率的預測能力表現較佳。
隨著債券殖利率持續攀升，近期愈來愈多華爾街分析師對股市前景轉趨謹慎。
殖利率走高通常被認為不利於風險性資產，近期在經濟與財政疑慮交織下，美債殖利率大幅上揚。上週，美國10年期與30年期公債殖利率雙雙觸及24年來高點。
儘管主要股價指數仍徘徊在歷史高點附近，但科技與人工智慧（AI）相關股票以外的個股持續承壓，市場表面之下的疲態正逐漸加深。
根據Ned Davis Research的分析，衡量市場上漲股票占比的市場廣度指標，相較於標普500指數整體水準，近期已降至歷史新低。
此外，Rosenberg Research的分析顯示，標普500指數成分股的股價中位數，較各自52週高點已下跌15%。
paras_en: U.S. equity indices continue to hover near historic highs, but fatigue is emerging within the market. The latest data from Bank of America shows that the closely watched Sell‑Side Indicator (SSI) keeps climbing and is now just one step away from triggering an official sell signal. Historical data indicate that when the indicator enters the sell zone, the S&P 500’s average return over the next 12 months is typically below its long‑term average.

According to Business Insider, Bank of America’s client report this week noted that the SSI rose from 56.4% in September to 57.2%, just 0.3 percentage points shy of the formal sell zone. This also marks the highest level for the indicator since March 2022.
The SSI is a contrarian market gauge: extreme pessimism may signal a buying opportunity, while extreme optimism can issue a sell warning.

Bank of America’s statistics show that when the SSI has previously triggered a sell signal, the S&P 500 still posted an average gain of about 3% over the following 12 months, but this lags sharply behind the roughly 10% historical average return.

The bank points out that, based on stock‑market data dating back to 1985, when the SSI is at its current level or higher there is a 36% chance the S&P 500 will deliver a negative return over the next 12 months.

Bank of America’s equity and quantitative research team says the SSI has long been a reliable contrarian indicator. Although it cannot capture every market move, its predictive power for the S&P 500’s total 12‑month return has historically outperformed other timing tools.
As bond yields keep climbing, an increasing number of Wall Street analysts are becoming more cautious about equity market prospects.

Rising yields are generally viewed as unfavorable for risk assets. Recently, amid intertwined economic and fiscal concerns, U.S. Treasury yields have surged sharply. Last week, both the 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields hit 24‑year highs.

Even though major equity indices remain near historic peaks, stocks outside the technology and artificial‑intelligence (AI) sectors continue to feel pressure, and the underlying market fatigue is deepening.

Ned Davis Research’s analysis of market‑breadth indicators – which measure the proportion of advancing stocks – shows that, relative to the overall S&P 500 level, the breadth metric has fallen to a historic low in recent weeks.
Rosenberg Research finds that the median price of S&P 500 component stocks is down about 15% from their respective 52‑week highs.

items.title: 美國期中選舉牽動美股！摩根大通點名「3大情境」：AI、醫療、能源股誰受惠？
paras: 美國期中選舉將於11月登場，選舉結果不僅攸關美國總統川普剩餘任期的國會主導權，也可能牽動華爾街投資布局。摩根大通(JPM-US) 指出，這次選舉的市場影響將比2024年總統大選更加複雜，投資人應根據不同選舉結果，重新評估產業前景與個股機會。
根據《Business Insider》報導，摩根大通策略師Dubravko Lakos-Bujas在致投資人的報告中指出，2024年總統大選期間，市場較容易依照潛在政策方向，判斷不同產業、投資主題及市場因子的影響；但本次期中選舉的結果與股市之間的關聯更為細緻，預料將更有利於選股策略。
傳統上，美國期中選舉經常造成國會兩院由不同政黨分別掌控的局面，形成政治僵局。這種情況通常受到華爾街青睞，投資人傾向延續既有市場趨勢，將資金集中於表現相對穩健的資產。
不過，摩根大通也將另外兩種情境納入分析，分別是民主黨大勝，以及共和黨繼續掌控國會兩院。
這三種結果可能帶來截然不同的政策環境，也將影響AI基礎設施、能源、醫療及金融等產業的投資前景。

情境一：國會陷入僵局，防禦、醫療及部分科技股受惠

若期中選舉後，國會兩院分屬不同政黨，白宮推動大規模立法的難度將明顯提高。對於擔憂政府支出過度擴張、監管趨嚴或大幅加稅的投資人而言，政治僵局反而可能成為市場利多。
Lakos-Bujas指出，自1950年以來，國會陷入僵局期間，標普500指數的表現普遍優於單一政黨全面掌控國會的情況。
以兩年國會任期計算，若以選舉日為起點，政治僵局期間標普500指數平均上漲21%，高於單一政黨掌控兩院時的18%；若以新一屆國會就任日為起點，政治僵局期間的平均漲幅則達25%，同樣高於單一政黨掌控時的18%。
在此情境下，摩根大通看好國防承包商、醫療保健企業，以及部分未高度仰賴AI資料中心建設的科技股。
若民主黨取得國會任一院的控制權，部分資料中心建設計畫可能受到阻礙。
摩根大通列出的潛在受惠企業包括埃克森美孚(XOM-US) 、家得寶(HD-US) 、福特汽車(F-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 。

情境二：民主黨掀起藍色浪潮，醫療與綠能產業看俏

民主黨若在11月期中選舉取得重大勝利，可能改變華府政策環境。
預測市場平台Polymarket目前給予民主黨掀起「藍色浪潮」（Blue Wave）約88%的機率。該平台將藍色浪潮定義為民主黨在眾議院取得超過218席，並在參議院取得超過49席。
然而，摩根大通認為，即使民主黨大勝，也不代表美國政策將全面轉向。
Lakos-Bujas表示：「藍色浪潮不太可能讓民主黨全面推動其政策議程，而是可能透過政府資金協商、國會監督，以及維持或撤銷現有政策等方式，在一定程度上改變政策環境。」
儘管如此，他的團隊仍看好醫療保健類股，因為民主黨掌控國會後，可能逆轉川普《大而美法案》（One Big Beautiful Bill Act，OBBBA）中的聯邦醫療補助計畫（Medicaid）削減措施。
此外，摩根大通也認為，藍色浪潮將是清潔能源產業的利多訊號，尤其有利於再生能源領域。
該行列出的潛在受惠企業包括Salesforce(CRM-US) 、卡爾瓦納(CVNA-US) 、新紀元能源(NEE-US) 、Xcel 能源(XEL-US) 及Ceco Environmental (CECO-US) 。

情境三：共和黨守住國會，AI基礎建設與傳統能源最受惠

摩根大通認為，若共和黨成功維持國會兩院控制權，將是科技股最有利的選舉結果，尤其有助於AI與基礎設施建設相關企業。
由於民主黨部分候選人已將反對資料中心擴建列為競選議題，共和黨繼續掌控國會，將有助於降低相關建設面臨的政策阻力。
Lakos-Bujas表示，共和黨維持國會主導權，可能透過延續現有政策、擴大財政支出、放寬監管及加快聯邦許可程序，為AI與基礎設施投資創造更有利的政策環境。
不過，摩根大通也看好其他有望受惠於監管放寬的企業。分析師表示，若共和黨繼續掌控國會，傳統能源、核能、金融及國防等產業也將受益。
該行列出的潛在受惠企業包括布魯姆能源(BE-US) 、聯合健康保險(UNH-US) 、洛克希德馬丁(LMT-US) 、CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 及美國銀行(BAC-US) 。

items.title: 美伊進入「關鍵一週」！是戰是談？美銀分析油價103美元面臨4大情境
paras: 美伊對峙進入關鍵階段。隨著外交談判陷入僵局、美軍持續向中東增兵，美國總統川普近期接連釋放強硬訊號，伊朗則在警告若遭軍事攻擊將發動「更具毀滅性」反擊的同時，仍強調外交大門尚未關閉。
伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araghchi）週日（4日）表示，伊朗仍願透過外交途徑尋求「公正且體面」的解決方案，但若敵方再次採取軍事行動，伊朗將予以比過去「更具毀滅性」的回擊。
川普上週末在白宮外接受媒體訪問時表示，針對伊朗問題，他將做出決定，「要不是走簡單的路，就是走困難的路」，但未說明具體時間表，只表示「你們會看到的」。
與此同時，美國高層近期也密集討論伊朗局勢。
根據《Axios》報導，美國副總統范斯（JD Vance）、國務卿盧比歐（Marco Rubio）、國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）、特使魏科夫（Steve Witkoff）、中央情報局局長拉特克里夫（John Ratcliffe）及參謀首長聯席會議主席凱恩（Dan Caine）上週五在戴維營舉行秘密會議，伊朗局勢及葉門胡塞武裝問題均列入議程。
美銀認為，目前布蘭特原油約每桶103美元的價格，正落在「零星衝突」與「密集交戰」兩種情境之間。
接下來，川普的決定、伊朗透過卡達傳遞的回應、葉門局勢、油輪遭襲情況、伊朗國內壓力，以及宏觀經濟因素，都可能左右油價下一步走向。

川普持續施壓 美軍增兵中東

川普近期不斷對伊朗施加外交壓力。他接受《時代》雜誌專訪時表示，如果美伊無法達成令美國滿意的協議，軍事行動可能在美國期中選舉後恢復。
同日晚間，川普在前往奧克拉荷馬州途中再度向記者表示，伊朗「要不簽署一份非常公平的協議，就不復存在」。
不過，伊朗仍試圖維持談判空間。阿拉格齊表示，伊朗代表團近期赴紐約出席聯合國大會期間，已提出一項旨在化解分歧、結束目前美伊敵對狀態的方案。若美方接受，荷姆茲海峽可在7天內重新開放。
阿拉格齊並稱，美國過去在軍事與外交領域均已遭遇失敗，對伊朗實施的新制裁也注定徒勞無功，呼籲美國選擇「明智理性」的道路。他強調，只有建立在正義與公平基礎上的外交及談判，才是解決問題的途徑。
在外交角力持續之際，美軍也正推進新一輪部署。
《華爾街日報》報導，西奧多·羅斯福號航空母艦打擊群已從聖地牙哥出發，「馬金島」號兩棲戒備群也已啟程，兩支編隊合計搭載逾7000名水兵及約2000名海軍陸戰隊員，預計10月底前後抵達中東。
屆時，美國在伊朗附近將形成3個航母打擊群的部署態勢。根據《彭博》報導，這種兵力集中程度自2003年伊拉克戰爭初期以來未曾出現。
《彭博》此前報導指出，伊朗官員認為，在11月3日期中選舉前達成協議的可能性相當低，選舉後局勢升級的可能性則很高，代表未來一至兩週可能成為期中選舉前最後一段相對可控的談判窗口。

胡塞武裝攻擊延燒 曼德海峽能源通道面臨風險

除了荷姆茲海峽，葉門局勢也讓能源供應面臨另一項風險。
葉門胡塞武裝3日晚間表示，為回應沙烏地阿拉伯對薩那及葉門其他地區發動空襲，胡塞武裝當天使用多枚彈道飛彈及無人機，攻擊位於沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的沙烏地阿美石油公司（Saudi Aramco）目標，並宣稱「成功實現目標」及「命中目標並引發火災」。
另一方面，《Axios》引述兩名美國官員報導指出，沙烏地阿拉伯計畫在未來數日對胡塞武裝發動大規模軍事行動，目標鎖定讓胡塞武裝得以控制曼德海峽的沿海地區。
據報導，相關行動將由葉門政府地面部隊主導，並由沙烏地空軍提供支援，重點攻擊胡塞武裝在沿海地區的戰略據點。
這場衝突同樣涉及能源利益。上月胡塞武裝攻占曼德海峽及約150公里紅海沿岸，而曼德海峽是沙烏地阿拉伯繞過荷姆茲海峽、向西方出口原油的重要替代通道。

美伊談判卡關 荷姆茲海峽重啟受7項條件限制

在談判方面，美伊雙方的歧異仍然明顯。
伊朗議長兼首席談判代表卡利巴夫（Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf）表示，除非伊朗提出的7項條件獲得滿足，否則荷姆茲海峽不會重新開放。他並表示，美國拖延談判及單方面提出要求的時代已經過去。
伊朗提出的7項條件包括解除海上封鎖、歸還遭凍結資產、取消伊朗石油出口制裁、停止以軍事威脅為由採取行動、終止對伊朗及其區域盟友的戰爭、撤離伊朗邊境周邊的美軍，以及賠償戰爭損失並承諾不干涉伊朗核與飛彈能力。
川普此前已拒絕以這些條件為基礎、在7天內重新開放荷姆茲海峽的方案，並認為伊朗的提議「遠遠不夠」。
伊朗方面則表示，將針對美方透過卡達傳遞的方案補充一些意見後再予以回覆。
《路透》引述知情人士指出，美伊目前的主要分歧並不在各項步驟本身，而在於這些步驟應以什麼順序推進。換言之，外交窗口尚未完全關閉，但談判空間正逐步縮小。

油價為何仍站上100美元？高盛：風險溢價未消退

儘管海灣地區的石油出口量已恢復至戰前水準，油價仍維持每桶100美元以上。
高盛大宗商品交易策略師Thomas Evans在週末報告中指出，供應面的緊張情勢雖已緩解，但市場風險溢價並未消失，期貨價格與價差仍維持在近期高位。
Evans估計，目前期現貨價差約為每桶20至25美元。他並警告，真正的風險在於，如果遭到攻擊導致海灣石油出貨量在數日內再次跌至50%以下，目前的供應緩衝將大幅縮小，屆時庫存與油價可能出現大幅跳升。
《彭博》引述 Energy Aspects 數據指出，全球石油庫存自3月以來已減少逾4億桶，目前約43億桶的總量處於5年低位。波斯灣至中國航線的油輪租金也已突破每日120萬美元。
此外，自上週四以來，阿曼南部海域至少發生4起油輪遭襲事件。若英國海事貿易行動組織（UKMTO）持續以目前頻率發布警告，仰賴「暗線出口」維持的供應恢復可能面臨更大壓力。
高盛全球石油及產品交易聯席主管Jerome Dortmans表示，伊朗擁有顯著干擾荷姆茲海峽石油出貨的能力，而美國向該地區增派第3個航母打擊群及1萬名海軍陸戰隊員，「絕對不是伊朗可以無視的訊號」。

油價面臨4種情境 103美元成為關鍵分界

在地緣政治風險升溫之際，美銀大宗商品團隊已將2026年下半年布蘭特原油基準預測從每桶83美元上調至95美元，理由是「零星衝突可能延續至年底」。
目前布蘭特約每桶103美元的價格，正處於零星衝突與密集交戰兩種情境之間。美銀提出4種可能走向：

達成協議、恢復諒解備忘錄：機率較低，荷姆茲海峽出貨量恢復至每日逾1000萬桶，2026年下半年布蘭特均價為83美元。
維持零星衝突：屬於基準情境，間歇性出貨約每日500萬桶，2026年下半年布蘭特均價為95美元。
恢復密集交戰：機率較低，布蘭特油價升至每桶120美元。
戰火波及能源基礎設施：屬於尾部風險，布蘭特均價可能達每桶150美元甚至更高。


根據美銀分析，接下來市場將密切觀察6項訊號，共同決定油價落在哪個情境區間：
首先是川普的「決定」。過去5天，他已3度釋放「你們會看到的」訊號，戴維營會議是否形成實質決定，以及是否有官方訊息對外公布，將成為本週最重要的觀察焦點。
其次是伊朗透過卡達傳遞的回應。伊朗方面表示仍需補充意見，雙方真正的分歧則集中在各項步驟的推進順序，這項僵局能否出現鬆動，將影響談判能否進入實質階段。
第三是葉門戰場發展。胡塞武裝正向塔茲至亞丁之間的最後一條公路推進，沙烏地阿拉伯針對曼德海峽沿岸的軍事行動是否取得進展，以及利雅德或胡賴斯是否遭到確認性攻擊，都將影響第二條能源通道的安全預期。
第四是阿曼南部油輪遭襲情況。自上週四以來已有至少4艘油輪遭到攻擊，若 UKMTO 持續發布相關警告，供應恢復可能受到實質衝擊。
第五是伊朗內部壓力，包括石油部長職位懸缺、里亞爾匯率跌至270萬兌1美元，以及通膨率逼近90%，都可能成為觀察德黑蘭談判立場的重要變數。
第六則是宏觀經濟因素。聯準會將於週三公布 FOMC 會議紀要，同期還有10年期及30年期美債標售；中國結束假期後也將於週四恢復交易，並面臨10月燃料出口暫停政策。高盛指出，目前油價與利率的聯動程度遠高於正常水準，因此宏觀因素同樣不容忽視。
Chatham House 研究員Aniseh Bassiri Tabrizi表示，雙方普遍希望達成協議，但彼此正逐漸走向更大的分歧。
在每桶103美元的油價背後，市場目前反映的仍是零星衝突延續的情境，但隨著美伊談判、軍事部署及葉門戰事同步發展，戰爭與外交談判之間的界線，本週可能進一步明朗。

items.title: 非農爆冷也救不了！美元、美債殖利率持續施壓金價  4000美元大關保衛戰本周開始？
items.title_en: Even a Cold Nonfarm Payroll Can't Save It! Dollar and US Treasury Yields Keep Pressuring Gold; $4,000 Barrier Defense Starts This Week?
paras: 今(5)日亞洲早盤，現貨黃金狹幅震盪於每盎司4144.52美元附近，4000美元關卡能否守住，將成為本週黃金多空決戰的焦點。
國際金價上周五(2日)再度收跌金價，盤中一度因美國9月非農就業數據大幅低於預期而飆逾1%至4226.51美元，但終場仍跌0.9%至4139.28美元，單周下跌約3.4%，美國COMEX期金亦收黑1%，結算價報4162.30美元。黃金漲勢被美元反彈和美債殖利率高企壓抑，所有貴金屬上周均下跌，華爾街情緒明顯轉空，散戶也首次失去7月底以來的看漲多數。
美國9月僅新增29000個就業崗位，薪資較去年同期成長放緩至3%。理論上，疲軟的就業數據會減輕Fed升息壓力，提升黃金相對於生息資產的吸引力，但金價上周依舊收跌，足以看出美元與債券市場帶來的強大壓制。金價想要走出有力反彈行情，需要美元與實際殖利率同步下檔。
與此同時，在金價處於歷史高點的背景下，亞洲多國開始挖掘本土黃金生產價值，推動黃金資源自主發展。
外媒最新報導指出，印尼打算對原生及半成品黃金徵收出口稅，稅率根據國際金價設定在7.5%至15%之間，目的是推動黃金在本國完成精煉加工。
南韓亦重啟實體黃金收購計畫，聯合本土精煉企業採購原本會出口的黃金，在國內充實儲備，降低對國際黃金市場的依賴。
此外，亞洲大國持續增持官方黃金儲備，將黃金視為戰略資源，不斷完善國內黃金供應鏈管控。新加坡與香港正擴大區域黃金基礎設施，新加坡搭建央行黃金倉儲體系，香港推出本地黃金清算試點，這類措施將長期有利於實體黃金需，提升區域黃金供給自主能力。
今年8月，國際金價迎來一波強勢上漲後，在4700美元附近遇阻回落，這一信號值得警惕。只要金價維持在4000美元上方，長期看漲結構就能夠保留，市場也在4300美元下方形成新的支撐區域。
當前黃金市場多空博弈僵持，一方面有穩定的亞洲大國需求及避險資金支撐，另一方面高油價、強勢美元和Fed再度緊縮貨幣政策的風險持續施壓。在貨幣政策壓力緩解前，金價想再度衝擊4700美元難度較高。
paras_en: In today’s (5th) Asian early session, spot gold was trading narrowly around $4,144.52 per ounce, and whether the $4,000 level can hold will be the focal point of this week’s gold bull‑bear showdown.

International gold prices fell again on Friday (the 2nd). During the session the price briefly surged more than 1% to $4,226.51 after September US non‑farm payrolls came in far below expectations, but closed down 0.9% at $4,139.28, a weekly drop of about 3.4%. US COMEX futures also closed lower, down 1%, with a settlement price of $4,162.30. The gold rally was suppressed by a rebounding dollar and high US Treasury yields, and all precious metals fell last week. Wall Street sentiment turned clearly bearish, and retail investors lost their bullish majority for the first time since late July.

September added only 29,000 jobs in the US and wages grew more slowly to 3% year‑on‑year. In theory, weak employment data should ease Fed rate‑hike pressure and make gold more attractive relative to interest‑bearing assets, but gold still closed lower last week, underscoring the strong drag from the dollar and bond markets. For gold to launch a solid rebound, both the dollar and real yields need to move lower together.
At the same time, with gold prices at historic highs, several Asian countries are beginning to tap the value of domestic gold production and promote self‑sufficient gold resource development.

Foreign media reports that Indonesia plans to levy an export tax on primary and semi‑finished gold, with rates set between 7.5% and 15% based on international gold prices, aiming to encourage refining of gold within the country.

South Korea has also revived a physical gold purchase program, partnering with domestic refiners to buy gold that would otherwise be exported, bolstering domestic reserves and reducing reliance on the international gold market.

Moreover, major Asian nations continue to increase official gold reserves, treating gold as a strategic resource and constantly improving domestic gold supply‑chain controls. Singapore and Hong Kong are expanding regional gold infrastructure—Singapore is building a central‑bank gold storage system, while Hong Kong has launched a local gold clearing pilot—measures that will long‑term benefit physical gold demand and enhance regional supply autonomy.

In August this year, after a strong rally, international gold prices stalled near $4,700 and pulled back, a signal worth watching. As long as gold stays above $4,000, the long‑term bullish structure can be preserved, and the market is forming a new support zone below $4,300.

The current gold market is locked in a stalemate: on one side there is steady demand from major Asian economies and hedge‑fund flows, while on the other side high oil prices, a strong dollar and the Fed’s renewed tightening pose ongoing pressure. Until monetary‑policy pressures ease, it will be difficult for gold to retake the $4,700 level.

items.title: 衝破70K大關！日經225狂飆逾1700點  美股期、黃金、白銀、比特幣全面拉升
items.title_en: Breaking the 70K Barrier! Nikkei 225 Soars Over 1,700 Points; US Futures, Gold, Silver, and Bitcoin All Rally
paras: 亞洲股市周一(5日)早盤風險情緒回暖，日股、貴金屬、加密貨幣同步走升，日經225指數大漲1728點、漲幅2.53%，美股三大期貨指數亦小幅走高，現貨黃金站上4158美元、白銀漲破61美元，比特幣攀漲近1.8%，主要因為市場認為美國9月就業遠遜預期，讓Fed本月中再度升息預期降溫，資金回流風險資產。
日股周一由半導體與AI供應鏈領攻，瑞薩電子漲逾7%，東京電子漲逾5%，愛德萬測試漲逾4%，東京精密、科意半導體、羅姆、軟銀等漲超3%，因美光最新財報優於預期，提振全球記憶體與AI伺服器鏈，加上外資加速回補亞太股市及日本資料中心與電力建設題材發酵。
外媒最新報導指出，日本擬以民間投資推動約1400億美元計畫，加速AI資料中心落地，進一步強化半導體與電力設備需求預期。
日本電力巨頭JERA、戴爾及英國AI基礎設施企業Rhaelm近日達成協議，將在東京附近投資150億美元，建造一座400兆瓦的資料中心。
JERA全球總裁金井幸雄表示，三家企業打算在五年內建成總規模3-4GW的AI資料中心配套燃氣發電基礎設施。「核心關鍵字是快速供電能力。」
JERA每年可交易3500萬噸液化天然氣，可為電站提供燃料。根據金井幸雄估算，1GW算力配套基建的造價在350億至450億美元之間。按此推算，建成上述規模基礎設施的總投入約需1400億美元。
日本本土擁有NTT資料、軟銀等大型資料中心營運商，黑石集團也打算未來數年在日本投入300億美元佈局相關業務。
paras_en: Asian markets on Monday (the 5th) saw risk sentiment improve in early trading, with Japanese equities, precious metals and cryptocurrencies all climbing. The Nikkei 225 jumped 1,728 points, up 2.53%, while the three major US futures indices edged higher. Spot gold rose above $4,158, silver broke $61, and Bitcoin gained nearly 1.8%, mainly because the market believes September US employment data will fall short of expectations, cooling expectations of another Fed rate hike this month and prompting a flow of capital back into risk assets.

Japanese stocks on Monday were led by the semiconductor and AI supply chain, with Renesas Electronics up more than 7%, Tokyo Electron up over 5%, Advantest up more than 4%, and Tokyo Seimitsu, Kioxia, Rohm, SoftBank and others gaining over 3%. The rally was fueled by Micron’s better‑than‑expected earnings, which lifted global memory and AI server chains, alongside accelerating foreign‑fund repurchases in Asia‑Pacific equities and growing interest in Japanese data‑center and power‑construction themes.

Foreign media reports say Japan plans to use private investment to drive a roughly $140 billion program that will accelerate the rollout of AI data centers, further strengthening expectations for semiconductor and power‑equipment demand.
Japanese power giant JERA, Dell and UK AI‑infrastructure firm Rhaelm recently reached an agreement to invest $15 billion near Tokyo to build a 400‑megawatt data center.

JERA Global President Yukio Kanai said the three companies aim to develop AI data‑center supporting gas‑power infrastructure with a total capacity of 3‑4 GW within five years. “The core keyword is rapid power‑supply capability,” he said.

JERA can trade 35 million tonnes of liquefied natural gas each year, providing fuel for power plants. Kanai estimates that the infrastructure to support 1 GW of compute power will cost between $35 billion and $45 billion. By that calculation, the total investment needed to build the aforementioned infrastructure would be about $140 billion.

Japan’s domestic operators such as NTT Data and SoftBank run large data‑center businesses, and Blackstone also plans to commit $30 billion over the coming years in Japan to develop related operations.

items.title: 軟銀孫正義罕見示警AI風險：超級智慧可能「極度危險」
paras: 長期看好人工智慧（AI）發展的軟銀集團（SoftBank）創辦人孫正義，近日罕見對 AI 潛在風險發出警告，直言隨著 AI 能力快速提升，若超級智慧落入錯誤人士手中，恐帶來極其危險的後果，呼籲各國放下對立、加強合作，共同應對日益強大的 AI 威脅。
孫正義週日（4日）在日本京都舉行的「社會中的科學與技術」（STS Forum）場邊活動中表示，AI 能力正以指數速度成長，各國建立互信、攜手管理這項技術已刻不容緩。
他強調，人類已沒有任何空間繼續陷入國際對抗，因為強大 AI 模型帶來的威脅，可能遠超人類彼此衝突所造成的風險。
這番言論與孫正義過去一貫樂觀看待 AI 發展的立場形成鮮明對比，也反映出隨著近期 AI 模型接連出現令人憂慮的安全漏洞，科技業對 AI 安全議題的關注持續升高。
對投資市場而言，AI 安全已逐漸從技術層面的討論，轉變為影響產業發展與監管政策的重要議題。

孫正義罕見轉趨謹慎 AI 安全疑慮升溫

現年 69 歲的孫正義是全球 AI 產業最積極的投資者與支持者之一。
軟銀旗下基金對 ChatGPT 開發商 OpenAI 的累計投資已接近 650 億美元，孫正義多年來也持續強調 AI 有望帶來龐大投資回報，並為人類社會創造更多價值。
然而，近期 AI 模型接連出現令人不安的安全漏洞，讓這位長期看好 AI 前景的投資人也開始釋出更謹慎的訊號。
孫正義在活動中警告，全球必須共同合作，因應日益強大的 AI 模型可能帶來的風險。他特別指出，超級智慧若落入錯誤之手，可能變得「超級危險」。

美國聯手 17 國推動 AI 科研 自動化實驗室成焦點

與孫正義同台發言的美國白宮科技政策顧問克拉齊奧斯（Michael Kratsios），則在京都宣布一項由美國主導、共有 17 國參與的倡議，目標是運用 AI 加速科學研究。
日本、韓國、英國、德國、新加坡及阿拉伯聯合大公國等國代表也出席相關活動，展現各國對 AI 科研應用的重視。
克拉齊奧斯描繪 AI 推動科學研究的未來場景，指出自動化雲端實驗室將能以工業規模運作，透過機器人系統同步進行數百項實驗，即時產生數據並回饋分析結果，進一步優化研究假設。
他也表示，AI 現在已具備整合數千篇研究論文的能力，能將原本需要數年的研究工作，濃縮為「由大量數位代理協助人類研究人員，在數十小時內完成」的任務。

孫正義預測 AI 三階段演進 2026 年進入物理世界

除了提醒各國重視 AI 安全，孫正義也再次闡述他對 AI 未來發展的長期預測，認為 AI 服務能力將持續以指數速度成長，並逐步從數位應用延伸至實體世界。
他指出，目前支援聊天機器人的技術，已經能協助 AI 服務瀏覽網頁、撰寫程式碼，同時消耗愈來愈多通用晶片算力。下一階段，相關程式預計從 2026 年起邁入第三階段，開始具備協助機器人及其他設備與物理世界互動的能力。
對於更長期的發展，孫正義重申先前提出的預測，認為到了 2040 年，具備學習能力的 AI 與機器將至少占全球國內生產毛額（GDP）的 20%，經濟規模相當於 46 兆美元。
他表示：「這僅僅是開始。」

items.title: 韓金融業炸鍋！多家主要銀行系統遭駭　客戶資料大規模外洩
items.title_en: South Korea's Financial Industry in Crisis! Major Bank Systems Hacked, Massive Customer Data Leak
paras: 近日，南韓金融體系遭遇前所未有的「駭客風暴」，因為從9月底至10月初，從耶加蘭儲蓄銀行到新韓、KB國民、韓亞、友利、NH農協等五大商業銀行，再到BNK釜山銀行，幾乎在同一時間內接連遭外部攻擊，客戶資訊大規模外洩，如此多重要金融機構同時遇襲，為南韓金融史上首見，引發監理層與民眾高度重視。
根據耶加蘭儲蓄銀行公告，上周三(9月30日)遭不明攻擊者入侵客戶資訊伺服器，約4萬人姓名、出生日期、電話等資料外洩，為該輪攻擊估算規模最大。其他銀行外洩規模相對較小，但新韓銀行約2.5萬名客戶資料流出，國民、韓亞銀行分別涉及119人、89人，釜山銀行則發生外包開發人員資訊被竊。攻擊面正從大行核心系統外溢至儲蓄銀行、外包平台等邊緣環節。
多家銀行與韓媒均指向「AI驅動」的新型攻擊模式。與傳統人工滲透不同，AI工具可自主掃描漏洞、測試憑證、擴大攻擊面，使防禦難度飆升。駭客並未直接衝擊網銀等核心交易系統，而是瞄準職員行動辦公、業務支援系統等「次核心」環節，這些區域儲存大量高價值數據，但安全等級偏低。
南韓金融監督院已派駐現場調查，金融委員會接連召開緊急會議，要求全面自查並研討處置方案。初步判斷，外部軟體漏洞是主要突破口，反映出南韓金融業長期依賴外包供應商、外圍系統安全投入不足、供應鏈審查缺位等深層隱憂。這次事件警示，在AI賦能網路攻擊的時代，金融安全防線亟待從核心向邊緣全面升級。
paras_en: Recently, South Korea's financial system has been hit by an unprecedented "hacker storm". From the end of September to early October, a series of external attacks struck major banks almost simultaneously—from Yegeon Savings Bank to Shinhan, KB Kookmin, Hana, Woori, NH Agricultural Cooperative, and even BNK Busan Bank—resulting in a massive leakage of customer information. Such a coordinated assault on so many key financial institutions is a first in South Korean financial history and has drawn intense attention from regulators and the public.

According to an announcement by Yegeon Savings Bank, an unknown attacker breached its customer information server on Wednesday, September 30, compromising the names, dates of birth, phone numbers and other data of about 40,000 individuals, making it the largest breach in this wave. The scale of leaks at other banks was smaller, but Shinhan Bank saw data of roughly 25,000 customers exposed, while KB Kookmin and Hana Bank were affected for 119 and 89 individuals respectively, and Busan Bank reported that information of outsourced developers was stolen. The attack surface is spreading from the core systems of large banks to savings banks and outsourced platforms at the periphery.

Several banks and Korean media point to a new "AI‑driven" attack model. Unlike traditional manual intrusion, AI tools can autonomously scan for vulnerabilities, test credentials and expand the attack surface, making defense far more difficult. Hackers did not directly hit core online‑banking or transaction systems; instead they targeted "secondary core" areas such as staff mobile workstations and business support systems, which store large amounts of high‑value data but have relatively low security levels.

The Financial Supervisory Service has dispatched teams to the scene, and the Financial Services Commission has convened emergency meetings, demanding a comprehensive self‑audit and the formulation of response plans. Preliminary assessments indicate that external software vulnerabilities were the main entry point, highlighting deep‑seated issues such as the industry's long‑standing reliance on outsourced vendors, insufficient investment in peripheral system security, and gaps in supply‑chain vetting. This incident warns that, in an era of AI‑enabled cyber attacks, the financial sector's security defenses must be upgraded comprehensively from the core out to the edges.

items.title: 輝達黃仁勳押注「美國DeepSeek」！AI新創Reflection擬推首款開放權重模型
paras: 獲得輝達(NVDA-US) 8 億美元投資的人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Reflection，正準備推出首款開放權重模型，瞄準目前由中國業者主導的開放 AI 模型市場，試圖為西方 AI 產業開闢新的競爭戰場。
根據《Axios》報導，Reflection 首款模型初期的能力預料仍不及美國頂尖尖端 AI 模型，但有望直接挑戰中國領先的開放權重模型。
知情人士指出，Reflection 的模型已具備相當程度的智慧能力，足以協助企業以較低成本打造專屬 AI 系統。
即使開放模型的能力略遜於頂尖閉源模型，只要結合企業自身的高品質資料，最終成果在某些情況下仍可能媲美成本最高的尖端 AI 系統。

開放權重模型崛起 中國領先、西方急起直追

開放權重模型與 ChatGPT、Claude 等閉源 AI 模型的主要差異，在於開發者可依照授權條款下載及修改模型本身，讓個人開發者與中小企業能更靈活地運用 AI 技術。
然而，目前全球最強大的開放權重模型幾乎都來自中國。在提供大量 AI 模型的平台上，開放模型的合計使用量有時甚至已占多數。
不過，在支出規模更大的企業 AI 市場，開放權重模型的滲透率仍相對有限。
多名 AI 公司高層與分析師指出，企業目前通常透過 API 及企業帳戶付費使用 AI 服務，開放權重模型在這類市場的普及程度仍不高。
Reflection 加入戰局，加上其他西方業者預計本月陸續推出開放權重模型，可能改變目前的市場競爭格局。知情人士透露，Reflection 發布模型後，還將有其他西方廠商跟進。
Reflection 執行長Misha Laskin曾任職於 Google。他先前接受《CNBC》訪問時坦言，公司要讓 AI 模型達到業界最先進水準仍需時間，並以火箭研發比喻模型開發的難度：「它們有點像火箭。要打造一枚大型火箭，需要時間。」
在模型正式推出前，Reflection 已開始與華盛頓及其他地區的相關人士接觸，介紹即將發布的模型，以及公司所倡議的「AI 工廠」概念。
不過，Reflection 尚未公布模型的確切發布日期及具體效能數據。
隨著 Reflection 等業者投入開放權重模型市場，AI 產業的競爭焦點也逐漸擴大。過去市場主要關注 OpenAI、Anthropic 與Google(GOOGL-US) 之間的頂尖閉源模型競爭，如今，誰能打造出最強大的開放權重模型，正成為另一項重要的產業競爭指標。

Reflection 力推「AI 工廠」 讓企業打造專屬 AI 系統

不過，Reflection 的目標不僅是推出開放權重模型，更希望打造「AI 工廠」，讓企業及政府機構結合自有資料、Reflection 模型與運算資源，建立高度客製化、成本更低的在地 AI 系統。
避險基金、交易公司等持有高度機密資料的機構，已對這種模式展現濃厚興趣。Reflection 也已開始推動相關計畫，今年 3 月與南韓新世界集團（Shinsegae Group）簽署合作備忘錄，計畫在韓國興建一座 250 MW 的 AI 工廠，採用 Reflection 模型及輝達晶片運作。
事實上，AI 工廠並非 Reflection 首創的概念，而是輝達執行長黃仁勳長期倡議的 AI 發展方向。
黃仁勳多次描繪未來企業運用 AI 的模式，透過結合 AI 運算硬體與開放模型，在保有資料所有權及控制權的前提下，打造企業專屬的 AI 系統。
根據《華爾街日報》與《The Information》先前報導，黃仁勳長期支持開放 AI 生態系，並大力支持 Reflection 朝打造頂尖開放 AI 系統的方向轉型。

輝達投資 8 億美元 Reflection 大舉鎖定算力資源

輝達在 Reflection 的發展布局中扮演重要角色，不僅投資 8 億美元，也是該公司最重要的財務支持者之一。
為支撐模型訓練及未來業務擴張，Reflection 近期也積極取得大型運算資源，與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及雲端運算公司 Nebius(NBIS-US) 簽訂大額合作協議。
今年 6 月，Reflection 與 SpaceX簽署協議，取得使用 SpaceX Colossus 2 資料中心內輝達 GB300 晶片的權利。
根據合約，自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起至 2029 年，在初期資源擴充階段結束後，Reflection 每月將向 SpaceX 支付 1.5 億美元。
協議也規定，雙方在合約生效前三個月後，均可提前 90 天通知終止合作。
此外，Reflection 今年 7 月也與雲端運算公司 Nebius達成協議，後者同意提供逾 10 億美元的運算資源，合約期限至 2029 年。該消息公布當天，Nebius 股價隨即下跌。
透過與 SpaceX 的合作，Reflection 不僅取得輝達高階晶片的運算資源，也進一步深化與輝達的合作關係。

items.title: 美國擔憂恐攻 部署在英國B-1轟炸機全部撤回
items.title_en: US Concerned About Terror Attack, All B‑1 Bombers Deployed in the UK Withdrawn
paras: 美國國防部一名官員表示，美國已將部署在英國皇家空軍費爾福德基地的B-1轟炸機全部撤回美國。
五角大廈一名發言人在郵件中寫道，「出於行動安全考量，我們無法實時證實裝備與部隊調動情況，但如今可以確認，所有部署於費爾福德皇家空軍基地的美軍轟炸機，均已重新調回美基地」。
費爾福德基地是美國空軍在歐洲展開行動的指揮前哨，也是美軍前沿作戰基地。
近幾個月英國同意美方使用該基地實施其所稱針對伊朗的防禦性打擊後，美軍轟炸機從這座基地起飛前往中東執行任務。美國B-1和B-52轟炸機就曾從該基地起飛執行針對伊朗的作戰任務。
據《路透社》4日（周日）報導，美方作出這一決定，是對該基地疑似恐怖襲擊陰謀的擔憂。上個月格洛斯特郡警方曾以涉嫌爆炸物犯罪和涉嫌策劃恐襲為由逮捕五名男子。
paras_en: A U.S. Department of Defense official said that the United States has withdrawn all B‑1 bombers that were deployed at the Royal Air Force’s Fairford base in the United Kingdom.

A Pentagon spokesperson wrote in an email, "For operational security reasons we cannot confirm equipment and troop movements in real time, but we can now confirm that all U.S. bombers stationed at RAF Fairford have been returned to U.S. bases."
Fairford is the forward command post for U.S. Air Force operations in Europe and serves as a forward operating base for U.S. forces.

In recent months, after the United Kingdom agreed to let the United States use the base for what it called defensive strikes against Iran, U.S. bombers took off from Fairford to the Middle East on missions. Both B‑1 and B‑52 bombers have launched from the base for operations targeting Iran.

According to Reuters on Sunday the 4th, the U.S. decision was driven by concerns over a suspected terrorist plot against the base. Last month, Gloucestershire police arrested five men on suspicion of explosives offences and alleged terrorist planning.

items.title: 憂過度依賴AI！華爾街積極「去集中化」：獲利修正等風險恐改變市場方向
items.title_en: Worried About Over‑Reliance on AI! Wall Street Actively “De‑centralizes”: Profit Corrections and Other Risks Could Shift Market Direction
paras: 隨著AI日益成為驅動美國金融市場和宏觀經濟的引擎，投資者在享受科技紅利的同時，正警惕因過度依賴AI而產生的潛在風險。
英國《金融時報》報導，面對AI相關資產在股市和債市的高度集中，基金經理人正積極尋找策略，以對沖技術情緒突變可能帶來的衝擊。
根據花旗集團最新研究，羅素1000指數中，超過三分之二的大型美國公司已直接與AI相關，或是商業模式深度融入該技術。
摩根大通的數據進一步揭示這一趨勢的廣泛性。在AI支出熱潮中，大型科技「超大規模企業」及其受益者大量發債，目前已佔據美國高等級債券市場的16%，成為投資級市場中的最大群體。
歐洲最大資產管理公司鋒裕匯理(Amundi)投資長Vincent Mortier指出，儘管AI主題「非常強大」，但客戶正在重新審視多元化配置的方式，但示警稱「獲利大幅修正」等意外事件恐改變市場方向。
貝萊德全球多元資產策略主管Ryan Marshall也表示，建構引入獨立、非相關回報來源的投資組合「絕對是當前需求所在」。他認為，除直接的AI曝險，其供應商如電力、基礎設施等「第二層同心圓」也與總體經濟成長高度綁定，這促使資金流向私募資產、避險基金等低相關性領域。
在具體策略上，富蘭克林鄧普頓聯合總裁Daniel Gamba透露，投資團隊正將AI視為一種「因子」，透過系統性對沖基金來構建對AI波動性敞口最小的投資組合。
Gamba也強調，雖然仍看好美國股票，但樂觀程度已不及年初，資金正明顯尋求多元化，轉向日本、新興市場以及短期固定收益產品。
Mortier則引用花旗前老闆Chuck Prince在2007年金融危機前的名言作為警示：「音樂還在播放，人們還在跳舞。」他也坦言，雖不知音樂停止的時機，但這正是多元化配置比以往任何時候都更為必要的原因。
paras_en: As AI increasingly becomes the engine driving the U.S. financial markets and macro‑economy, investors are enjoying the tech dividend while warning of potential risks from over‑reliance on AI.

The Financial Times reported that, faced with the high concentration of AI‑related assets in equities and bonds, fund managers are actively seeking strategies to hedge against the impact of sudden shifts in tech sentiment.

According to Citi’s latest research, more than two‑thirds of the large U.S. companies in the Russell 1000 index are either directly tied to AI or have business models deeply integrated with the technology.

JPMorgan data further reveal the breadth of this trend. In the AI‑spending boom, large‑cap “mega‑scale enterprises” and their beneficiaries have issued massive amounts of debt, now accounting for 16% of the U.S. high‑grade bond market, making them the largest group in the investment‑grade space.

Vincent Mortier, Head of Investments at Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi, said that although the AI theme is “very strong,” clients are re‑examining diversification approaches and warned that unexpected events such as “large profit revisions” could change market direction.

Ryan Marshall, Global Multi‑Asset Strategy Head at BlackRock, also noted that building portfolios that incorporate independent, non‑correlated sources of return “is absolutely the current demand.” He added that beyond direct AI exposure, its suppliers—such as power and infrastructure firms in the “second‑layer concentric circle”—are tightly linked to overall economic growth, prompting capital to flow into private‑equity, hedge‑fund and other low‑correlation assets.

In terms of concrete tactics, Daniel Gamba, Co‑President of Franklin Templeton, said his investment team treats AI as a “factor” and constructs portfolios with minimal AI‑volatility exposure by using systematic hedge‑fund strategies.

Gamba also stressed that while he remains bullish on U.S. equities, his optimism is lower than at the start of the year, with capital clearly seeking diversification by shifting toward Japan, emerging markets and short‑term fixed‑income products.

Mortier quoted former Citi CEO Chuck Prince’s pre‑2007‑crisis warning: “The music is still playing, and people are still dancing.” He admitted he doesn’t know when the music will stop, but that uncertainty makes diversification more necessary than ever.

Last week two senior Federal Reserve officials argued that more data should be gathered before deciding the next monetary‑policy move, prompting market participants to stop betting on a rate hike at the Fed’s late‑October meeting. However, reports of the United States sending additional troops and an aircraft carrier to the Middle East and China suspending oil‑product exports sent oil prices soaring and U.S. Treasury yields climbing to their highest level since 2002, supporting the dollar near a 17‑month high. Meanwhile, Japan’s August unemployment rate rose to 2.5% according to Friday’s data, the job‑seeking ratio held steady at 1.18, and Tokyo’s September core CPI accelerated 2.7% year‑on‑year – the biggest rise in ten months and above expectations. This figure is widely seen as a leading indicator of nationwide inflation and will be one of the factors the Bank of Japan (BOJ) considers when updating its quarterly inflation forecast at its October 29‑30 policy meeting, providing a rationale for further rate hikes. Although bets on consecutive BOJ hikes have faded, many still expect a hike in December, which could boost the yen and pull USD/JPY down from its 158.21 peak.

According to Japan’s Finance Minister Shiroi, Japan is no longer in deflation, so there is no need for overly accommodative policy aimed at chasing higher inflation, which should support the yen. At the same time, the U.S. Labor Department reported that September non‑farm payrolls rose by only 29,000 jobs and the unemployment rate climbed to 4.2%, while average hourly earnings edged up 0.1% from the previous month – all below expectations. August job gains were revised down to 133,000, and August factory orders rose 0.1% in line with forecasts, but durable‑goods orders fell 0.1% month‑over‑month, missing estimates. These weak data caused the rate‑futures market to slash the probability of a Fed hike in October to below 20%, pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 156.94, though the market still expects the Fed to maintain a hawkish stance, helping the dollar recover some losses. The dollar‑yen resistance today is projected at 157.70‑90 with support at 156.70‑90.

Sources said on Friday that diplomatic prospects look bleak; if the United States resumes large‑scale military strikes, Iran is poised to launch a strong retaliation against new U.S. attacks, heightening risk‑off sentiment and pushing the Australian and New Zealand dollars toward multi‑month lows. At the same time, growing concerns over France’s debt issues have weighed on the euro, pulling EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1220.

Eurostat data released later showed that the Eurozone’s September Harmonised CPI (HICP) preliminary reading rose to 3.8% on the back of higher fuel and natural‑gas prices, pushing overall inflation further above the European Central Bank’s 2% target and adding pressure for another rate hike. Bundesbank President Nagel said strong export demand and government investment are driving Germany’s growth forecast to about 1% this year – roughly double the latest estimate – and weak U.S. employment data have hurt the dollar, lifting the euro to a high of 1.1285. The euro‑dollar resistance today is estimated at 1.1250‑70 with support at 1.1160‑80.

On Friday, the pound fell to a low of 1.3178 against the dollar. Worsening fiscal outlooks in several heavily indebted European countries have also dragged the euro down against the pound, while weak U.S. jobs data have hurt the dollar, pushing the pound up to a high of 1.3255. paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，投資銀行摩根士丹利 (Morgan Stanley) 外匯策略團隊於近期發布的研究報告中公開承認預測失誤，表示原先看空美元的理由已不復存在，並同步調升今年底至 2027 年的美元指數與主要貨幣目標價。
衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣價值的美元指數 (DXY) 近期強勢走高，本週攀升至 101 附近，創近八週新高。美元走強雖提升了美國民眾海外消費的購買力，卻也令美國出口商品成本上升。近期連美國總統川普在會晤日本首相高市早苗時，亦公開提及對日元過度貶值的關切。
由 David S. Adams 領軍的小摩外匯策略團隊在報告中坦言：「我們錯了！」
小摩團隊先前預期美元將於今年下半年持續下行、年底觸底，並至 2027 年轉強，該預測建立在美國與全球利差將縮小、聯準會 (Fed) 暫停升息而其他央行追趕的假設上。
然而，居高不下的能源價格與強勁的美國經濟數據，促使聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 展現偏鷹派政策立場，使美國進一步升息的可能性大幅增加。
根據 CME FedWatch 利率期貨數據顯示，市場預期 Fed 於 10 月會議升息 1 碼 (至 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間)) 的機率已達 68.6%，12 月再度升息 1 碼的機率亦超過五成。
摩根士丹利指出，市場仍有相當大的空間繼續推升升息預期，這將為美元提供穩固的支撐力量。
因應基本面變化，摩根士丹利全面調升美元目標價：

將今年底美元指數預測由原先的 96 大幅上修至 102；
歐元兌美元由 1.20 下調至 1.12 美元；
英鎊兌美元由 1.38 下調至 1.30 美元；
美元兌日元則由 157 上調至 159 日元。


展望 2027 年年中，隨著歐洲政治與財政疑慮再現，預期美元指數將上看 104，歐元兌美元可能進一步走軟至 1.10 美元。在交易策略上，團隊建議可於美元兌日元 158 時建立多頭部位，目標價看 163 日元，停損價設於 150 日元。
不過，摩根士丹利亦提出幾點風險警示。
首先，美元此波強勢主要集中於對抗日元、歐元及瑞士法郎等低利率融資貨幣，而澳元及挪威克朗等商品貨幣仍將維持相對強勢。
其次，部分貶值預期已反映於市場期權價格中，變動幅度可能相對有限。
最後，政治與政策等突發事件仍可能引發震盪，例如關稅政策宣佈或外匯干預等黑天鵝事件，都可能引發美元多頭部位的連鎖停損賣壓。
事實上，不僅是小摩，一些投行也紛紛看多美元。
德國商業銀行分析師 Thu Lan Nguyen 指出，Fed 9 月一致決議升息，暫時恢復了市場對其政策可信度的信心，並支撐美元。該行因此將今年底歐元兌美元預測從 1.17 下修至 1.15，預期 Fed 年底前還會升息一次；此前該行預估 Fed 將維持利率不變。

paras_en: Morgan Stanley’s foreign‑exchange strategy team publicly admitted a forecasting error in a recent research report, stating that the reasons for a short position on the dollar no longer exist and simultaneously raised its year‑end to 2027 targets for the dollar index and major currencies.

The dollar index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, has recently surged, climbing to around 101 this week and setting a new high for nearly eight weeks. While a stronger dollar boosts the purchasing power of U.S. consumers abroad, it also raises the cost of U.S. exports. President Trump recently voiced concerns about the excessive depreciation of the yen during a meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.
Led by David S. Adams, the Morgan Stanley FX team admitted, “We were wrong!”

The team had previously expected the dollar to continue falling in the second half of the year, bottoming out by year‑end and strengthening by 2027, based on assumptions that U.S. and global interest‑rate spreads would narrow, the Fed would pause rate hikes while other central banks would catch up.

However, persistently high energy prices and robust U.S. economic data have prompted the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to adopt a hawkish stance, greatly increasing the likelihood of further U.S. rate hikes.

CME FedWatch futures data show that the market now assigns a 68.6% probability to a 25‑basis‑point hike at the October meeting (raising the policy range to 4.00%–4.25%) and more than 50% probability of another 25‑basis‑point hike in December.
Morgan Stanley notes that there remains substantial room for the market to further lift rate‑hike expectations, which would provide solid support for the dollar.
In response to changing fundamentals, Morgan Stanley has fully revised its dollar targets:

The year‑end DXY forecast has been sharply raised from 96 to 102; the EUR/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.20 to 1.12; the GBP/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.38 to 1.30; and the USD/JPY forecast has been raised from 157 to 159.

Looking ahead to mid‑2027, as European political and fiscal concerns resurface, the dollar index is expected to rise to 104, with the euro potentially softening further to 1.10. In trading terms, the team recommends taking a long position at USD/JPY 158 with a target of 163 and a stop‑loss at 150.
Nonetheless, Morgan Stanley issued several risk warnings.

First, the dollar’s recent strength is mainly focused on countering low‑rate currencies such as the yen, euro, and Swiss franc, while commodity currencies like the AUD and NOK will remain relatively strong.
Second, some depreciation expectations are already reflected in market option prices, so the upside may be limited.
Finally, political and policy shocks—such as tariff announcements or foreign‑exchange interventions—could trigger chain stop‑loss selling of dollar long positions.
In fact, it is not only Morgan Stanley; other investment banks are also bullish on the dollar.

German commercial bank analyst Thu Lan Nguyen noted that the Fed’s unanimous rate hike in September temporarily restored market confidence in its policy credibility and supported the dollar. The bank therefore lowered its year‑end EUR/USD forecast from 1.17 to 1.15 and expects another Fed hike before year‑end, after previously predicting a pause.

Looking to 2027, the German commercial bank believes that U.S. and euro‑area rate‑hike expectations may be cut, but the dollar will face greater pressure, and the euro may gradually recover against the dollar.

The bank expects the Fed to keep rates unchanged after the December 2023 hike until the end of 2027, and if the Middle‑East crisis eases and inflationary shocks subside, the Fed could also cut rates before the end of 2027; the White House’s influence on Fed independence is another pressure source for the dollar.
(Duplicate paragraph 18 and 19 omitted for brevity)

MUFG’s September 18 report stated that Fed hikes and hawkish signals support the dollar, while the Bank of Japan’s post‑hike stance fell short of market expectations, leaving short‑term upside for USD/JPY. However, MUFG did not significantly raise its dollar forecast, still projecting a 4.2% decline in the DXY by Q2 2027 from the report’s level, as other G10 central banks may continue to hike, potentially preventing spreads from widening favorably for the dollar.

Regarding the yen, MUFG expects the Bank of Japan to hike again in January and June 2027, raising the policy rate to 1.75%. Thus, while USD/JPY may continue to rise in the short term, subsequent hikes and intervention risk will likely cap gains; the bank expects buying pressure to weaken before the 160‑yen breakout.

items.title: 9月就業僅增2.9萬人 Fed可能放緩升息？Hammack：不急著決定下一步
items.title_en: September Jobs Up Only 29,000; Fed May Slow Rate Hikes? Hammack: No Rush to Decide Next Move
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁、2026年FOMC票委Hammack周五(2日)表示,聯準會在決定下一步貨幣政策前仍有充足時間評估最新經濟數據,暗示即使9月就業報告明顯疲弱,決策官員仍不急於在10月底的政策會議上採取行動。
Hammack接受PBS NewsHour訪問時表示,9月非農就業數據雖然表面上相當疲弱,但整體仍符合近期美國就業市場的發展趨勢。美國勞工部當天公布,9月非農就業人口僅增加2.9萬人,遠低於經濟學家預期的約9萬人,失業率則由8月的4.1%升至4.2%。
Hammack指出,如果拉長觀察時間,過去12個月美國平均每月新增就業約4.1萬人,大致符合她對維持勞動市場穩定所需的「損益平衡」就業增幅估計。因此,她認為最新數據並未完全改變對就業市場的判斷,而是延續近期招聘速度放緩的趨勢。
她表示,聯準會在10月底的下一次政策會議前仍會取得更多經濟資訊,因此現在仍有時間判斷最合適的貨幣政策立場。聯準會下一次聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議預定於10月27日至28日舉行。
聯準會9月會議已將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調25個基點至3.75%至4%,並在最新經濟預測中暗示今年底前可能再升息一次。不過,近期多名聯準會官員表示,沒有必要急於在10月會議立即再次升息,決策仍將取決於後續通膨、就業及經濟活動數據。
Hammack長期以來是聯準會內部較早主張升息以抑制通膨的官員之一。她此前多次表示,美國通膨仍高於聯準會2%的長期目標,如果價格壓力沒有進一步降溫,貨幣政策可能需要維持限制性立場,甚至進一步升息。Hammack 是2026年的FOMC票委，而且是有投票權的成員。
她9月25日曾表示,美國通膨持續高於目標超過5年,最大的風險之一是民眾逐漸形成接受高物價的通膨心態。她當時指出,聯準會需要確保政策維持在足夠限制性的水準,以推動通膨回到2%目標。
不過,最新就業數據讓聯準會面臨更加複雜的政策取捨。9月新增就業2.9萬人,不僅遠低於市場預期,8月新增就業人數也遭下修。失業率從4.1%升至4.2%,顯示勞動市場降溫程度正在加深。
市場因此大幅降低10月升息的預期。利率期貨數據顯示,截至周五,投資人預期聯準會10月會議升息的機率已降至不到20%,低於數據公布前的逾25%。市場同時下調12月升息押注,但仍認為今年底前再次升息存在相當可能性,12月升息機率仍接近90%。
政策預期的變化反映聯準會目前面臨兩項相互牽制的風險。一方面,通膨仍高於2%目標,能源價格上升以及地緣政治衝突可能進一步推升價格壓力；另一方面,如果聯準會持續升息或讓利率在高檔維持過久,則可能加劇就業市場降溫並對經濟活動造成壓力。
近期能源價格成為聯準會評估通膨的重要變數。伊朗戰事及中東能源供應受到干擾後,油價明顯上升,可能透過汽油、運輸及生產成本向其他商品與服務傳導。聯準會官員因此必須判斷近期通膨升溫究竟是短期能源衝擊,還是會進一步擴散至更廣泛的核心價格。
聯準會主席Kevin Warsh近期並未明確透露下一次升息的時間,但曾表示,如果政策制定者無法確認潛在通膨正以足夠速度朝2%目標下降,聯準會仍有進一步工作的必要。
紐約聯準銀行總裁John Williams本周也表示,政策官員目前沒有立即升息的急迫性,需要先觀察更多數據,但他仍認為今年底前再次升息具有合理性。聯準會副主席Philip Jefferson則表示,未來任何政策調整都應根據數據趨勢、經濟前景及風險平衡作出判斷,決策官員可能需要更多時間。
目前聯準會政策利率已處於3.75%至4%的區間,高於今年稍早的水準。9月會議公布的預測顯示,多數官員仍認為今年底前需要進一步收緊政策,但最新就業數據使10月立即升息的可能性明顯降低。
對Hammack而言,9月就業數據並不足以單獨決定政策方向。她強調,在10月27日至28日會議前仍有大量資料可供分析,包括通膨、就業及其他經濟活動指標。聯準會將在取得更多數據後,再決定如何在抑制通膨與維持就業市場穩定之間取得平衡。
市場目前因此將焦點轉向接下來公布的通膨數據及聯準會9月會議紀要。若通膨持續高於預期,政策官員可能重新提高對年底升息的支持；若就業市場進一步惡化,則可能增加聯準會暫緩升息的理由。10月底會議前的數據走向,將成為決定聯準會今年最後一次政策調整時機的關鍵。
paras_en: Federal Reserve (Fed) Cleveland Fed President and 2026 FOMC voting member Hammack said on Friday the Fed still has ample time to assess the latest economic data before deciding its next monetary policy step, suggesting that even with a clearly weak September jobs report, policymakers are not in a hurry to act at the policy meeting at the end of October.

In an interview with PBS NewsHour, Hammack noted that while September non‑farm payrolls look weak on the surface, they are still consistent with the recent trend in the U.S. labor market. The Labor Department reported that non‑farm employment rose by only 29,000 jobs in September, far below economists’ estimate of about 90,000, and the unemployment rate rose from 4.1% in August to 4.2%.

Hammack pointed out that over the past 12 months the U.S. has added an average of roughly 41,000 jobs per month, which roughly matches her estimate of the “break‑even” hiring pace needed to keep the labor market stable. Therefore, she believes the latest data does not fundamentally change her view of the labor market, but rather continues the recent slowdown in hiring speed.

She said the Fed will obtain more economic information before its next policy meeting at the end of October, so there is still time now to determine the most appropriate monetary‑policy stance. The next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting is scheduled for October 27‑28.

The Fed’s September meeting raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4.0% and, in its latest economic projections, hinted at a possible additional hike before the end of the year. However, several Fed officials recently have said there is no need to rush into another hike at the October meeting; the decision will depend on subsequent inflation, employment and activity data.

Hammack has long been one of the Fed’s earlier voices advocating rate hikes to curb inflation. She has repeatedly said U.S. inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target and, if price pressures do not ease further, policy may need to stay restrictive or even tighten further. Hammack is a voting member of the 2026 FOMC.

On September 25 she warned that U.S. inflation has stayed above target for more than five years, and one of the biggest risks is that the public gradually becomes accustomed to high‑price inflation. She said the Fed must keep policy sufficiently restrictive to bring inflation back to the 2% goal.

Nevertheless, the latest jobs data complicates the Fed’s policy calculus. September’s addition of 29,000 jobs was far below expectations, and August’s job gains were also revised down. The unemployment rate’s rise from 4.1% to 4.2% shows a deepening cooling of the labor market.

As a result, markets have sharply trimmed expectations for an October hike. Futures data showed that by Friday investors’ probability of a rate increase at the October meeting had fallen to under 20%, down from more than 25% before the data release. The market also lowered its December hike bets, though it still sees a fairly high chance—near 90%—of another hike before year‑end.

The shift in policy expectations reflects two opposing risks the Fed now faces. On one hand, inflation remains above the 2% target, with rising energy prices and geopolitical tensions potentially adding further price pressure; on the other hand, continued tightening or keeping rates high for too long could further cool the labor market and weigh on economic activity.

Recent energy price movements have become a key variable in the Fed’s inflation assessment. After the Iran conflict and disruptions to Middle‑East energy supplies, oil prices rose noticeably, potentially passing through higher gasoline, transportation and production costs to other goods and services. Fed officials therefore must judge whether the recent inflation uptick is a short‑term energy shock or could spread to broader core prices.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has not explicitly indicated the timing of the next hike, but he has said that if policymakers cannot confirm that underlying inflation is falling toward the 2% goal at a sufficient pace, further action may be needed.

New York Fed President John Williams said this week that policymakers do not feel an immediate urgency to raise rates and need to observe more data, though he still believes a year‑end hike remains reasonable. Vice‑Chair Philip Jefferson added that any future policy adjustment should be based on data trends, economic outlook and risk balance, and that officials may need more time.

The Fed’s policy rate is currently in the 3.75%‑4.0% range, higher than earlier this year. The September projections showed most officials still thought further tightening would be required before year‑end, but the latest jobs data has markedly reduced the odds of an immediate October hike.

For Hammack, September’s jobs numbers alone are insufficient to dictate policy direction. She emphasized that a large amount of data—including inflation, employment and other activity indicators—will be available for analysis before the October 27‑28 meeting. The Fed will decide how to balance inflation control with labor‑market stability after gathering more information.

Markets have now shifted focus to upcoming inflation releases and the Fed’s September meeting minutes. If inflation stays above expectations, officials may renew support for a year‑end hike; if the labor market worsens further, they may find more reason to pause. The data trajectory before the end‑October meeting will be pivotal in timing the Fed’s final policy move of the year.

paras: 美元周五(2日)下跌，但仍連續第4周兌歐元走升。在歐洲政府公債遭遇拋售、以及市場預期聯準會(Fed)將維持鷹派升息立場的背景下，美國公債殖利率維持高檔，為美元提供支撐。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報101.88，仍連續第3周上漲。
美國公布9月就業成長低於經濟學家預期、失業率小幅升至4.2%後，美元近期部分漲幅有所收斂。10年期美國公債殖利率也在數據公布後下滑，隨後回升5.14個基點至5.285%。
儘管如此，美元仍受到多項因素支撐，包括美國公債殖利率維持在數十年高點附近、部分歐洲國家財政前景的疑慮升溫，以及油價上漲。原油價格走高促使部分投資人降低對主要能源進口國貨幣的曝險，包括歐元與日元。
歐元對美元上漲0.13%，至1.12580美元。歐元兌美元連續第4周下跌，創下2025年5月中旬以來最長連續周跌勢。
野村G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，「如果把這些就業數據放在一起看，我認為這其實是一組相當理想的金髮女孩(Goldilocks)數據：經濟活動仍相當具韌性，但並未產生明顯的通膨壓力。」
他表示，「從整體經濟角度來看，這是個不錯的背景。對整體風險資產及高Beta貨幣而言，這應該是相對有利的數據。這對聯準會利率定價的影響可能也不大，但至少降低了聯準會是否會在10月再次升息的尾部風險。」
美國央行在9月政策會議結束後升息，並釋放進一步升息的訊號。儘管美國總統川普一再要求降低借貸成本，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)仍重申貨幣政策的獨立性。市場對此做出反應，提高了對聯準會進一步緊縮政策的押注。
根據CME Group的FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為86%，高於一周前的36%。
美元兌瑞郎下跌0.30%，至0.8285瑞郎。
美元兌日元也下跌0.15%，至每美元157.81日元，但仍連續第3周上漲。
歐洲市場的擔憂
歐洲國家周五同意釋放柴油庫存。美國總統川普此前曾施壓各國政府採取這項措施，希望壓低與伊朗戰爭相關、持續飆升的燃料價格。
未來幾個月歐元區通膨率可能進一步上升，使歐洲央行(ECB)面臨升息壓力。
近幾周，法國與義大利政府公債持續承受賣壓，市場預期政策利率將上升，加上2027年大選逼近、政治風險升高，使市場更加謹慎。法國10年期公債殖利率周四飆升至2002年以來最高水準。
周五，法國10年期公債殖利率相較避險性較高的德國公債殖利率溢價擴大至150個基點以上，創2011年底以來最高，因市場對法國財政狀況與政治動盪的擔憂加劇。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Friday (the 2nd) but still posted its fourth straight weekly gain against the euro. With European sovereign bonds under pressure and markets expecting the Federal Reserve to maintain a hawkish rate‑hike stance, U.S. Treasury yields stayed elevated, underpinning the greenback.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.1% to 101.88, marking a third consecutive week of rise.

After the U.S. reported September job growth below economists’ forecasts and a modest rise in the unemployment rate to 4.2%, the dollar’s recent gains moderated. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield also fell after the data release, then rebounded 5.14 basis points to 5.285%.

Nevertheless, the dollar remains supported by several factors, including Treasury yields lingering near multi‑decade highs, growing doubts over the fiscal outlook of some European nations, and higher oil prices. Rising crude has prompted some investors to cut exposure to currencies of major energy‑importing countries, such as the euro and the yen.
The euro rose 0.13% against the dollar to $1.12580. The euro‑dollar pair has now slipped for four straight weeks, the longest weekly decline streak since mid‑May 2025.

Nomura G10 FX strategy head Dominic Bunning said, “If you look at these employment numbers together, I think they actually represent a fairly Goldilocks set of data: economic activity remains quite resilient, yet there’s no clear inflationary pressure.”

He added, “From an overall economic perspective, that’s a decent backdrop. For risk assets and high‑beta currencies, it should be relatively favourable. The impact on Fed rate pricing may be limited, but at least it reduces the tail‑risk of another Fed hike in October.”

The U.S. central bank raised rates after its September policy meeting and signaled the possibility of further hikes. Although President Trump repeatedly urged lower borrowing costs, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated the independence of monetary policy. Markets reacted by increasing bets on additional Fed tightening.
According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, traders now assign an 86% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged later this month, up from 36% a week earlier.
The dollar fell 0.30% against the Swiss franc, to 0.8285 CHF per dollar.
The dollar also slipped 0.15% against the yen, to ¥157.81 per dollar, but still posted a third straight weekly gain.
European market concerns

European countries on Friday agreed to release diesel inventories. President Trump had previously pressured governments to take this step, hoping to curb fuel prices that have surged amid the war with Iran.
In the coming months, euro‑area inflation could rise further, putting pressure on the European Central Bank to hike rates.

In recent weeks, French and Italian sovereign bonds have faced sustained selling pressure as markets anticipate higher policy rates. With the 2027 election looming and political risk rising, investors have become more cautious. French 10‑year yields spiked on Thursday to their highest level since 2002.

On Friday, the spread between French 10‑year yields and the relatively safer German 10‑year yields widened to over 150 basis points, the widest since the end of 2011, reflecting heightened concerns over France’s fiscal health and political turmoil.
The euro fell 0.15% against the Swiss franc, to 0.9327 CHF per euro.
The euro was flat against the yen at ¥177.67 per euro.
